Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: {THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?
EN: But that was your problem. {Beat}Anyway, front gate was open, no way I was letting {emph}you get in first. {Slight confusion}I walk in... there's a flash... and I'm here.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: {THEATER: 1st Time, Hates player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: {THEATER: 1st Time, Likes player}How did you get from the Gala Event to here?
EN: Also meant the front gate was open, and no way was I missing it after all these years. Then... I walk in... and...

Speaker: God
EN: {Snarling}I'm in control. The Master won't help Dog now... and it won't help you.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Snarling}Not listen, {emph}Dog out of cage now.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Don't let him spot you! If he does, talk him down before he has a chance to ignite the gas.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Shut off the gas valves, or that idiot'll kill us all.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: That idiot's opened the gas valves! A single spark - or he sets off his collar, the casino's going to burn. Us along with him.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: What weapons are you good at?
EN: Dog is better at the baser instincts than I... I merely have the brain for it.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: What weapons are you good at?
EN: His sinew and muscle are difficult to move consciously... he's always hungry, clumsy, heavy.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: What weapons are you good at?
EN: Dog good at punching... hitting people with metal bear jaw until they go quiet.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: What weapons are you good at?
EN: {Thinking}Dog sometimes pick up club when thing need to hit is big, need to punch in many places.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What weapons are you skilled with?
EN: Not one for fighting if we can avoid it. Still, wasn't bad at the pistol range and over the years, I've learned how to handle a knife...

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What weapons are you skilled with?
EN: {Little quieter}...and explosives a bit. A bit. {To himself}Made a lot of mistakes along the way. Still have my fingers, though.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Oh, is that all? Guess that'll do.
EN: [She makes a disapproving frown, shakes her head.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You seem like you've been well-trained.
EN: [She shrugs slightly, then waits.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Energy Weapons, Explosives, Melee, Unarmed, and Guns. Is that all?
EN: [She nods. Once.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: What weapons are you skilled at?
EN: [Christine draws a jagged lightning bolt in the air, pantomimes throwing a grenade, and then pulls an imaginary knife from behind her back.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: What weapons are you skilled at?
EN: [Then she moves her feet shoulder width apart, holds hands up in a martial arts stance, then turns both hands into pistols, pantomimes rapid-firing.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: What weapons are you skilled at?
EN: [She then holds one pistol up, takes aim as if sighting along the barrel and does a single shot, ends with a nod.]

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Pleased}Good, well done... now, for the festivities, {colder}and your parts in all this.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Hologram Head at Fountain. Next instructions for Act 2 Gala: Initially pleased, then brutal, contemptuous, clear. Goal: Player = Good Dog.
EN: The owner of the Sierra Madre... {disgusted, thinks this was an idiotic move}for whatever reason... keyed the Grand Opening to the Gala Event itself.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: Irritated at this, this makes no sense to him as a scientist. It's what happens when you put fools in charge of things, grumble, grumble.
EN: It needs to be fired off in order for the casino doors to open. {Grumbles}As I've discovered, {emph}one person can't do it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: So, get your team in position indicated on your Pip-Boy, then trigger it properly.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: You're so close now, don't let me down. {Beat}Otherwise, I'll have to rely on the {emph}next team.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: What do you need me to do now?
EN: Gather the three others needed for this job, return them here. After that, I'll have more instructions for you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: What do you need me to do now?
EN: Take the others to their positions to trigger the Gala Event. After that, the doors of the Sierra Madre should open.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Hardcore Only}No... while it will erode your health, {need to be clear, slow, here}it will only bring you to the point of death, no farther. At that point...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: The air here is lethal only if you enter concentrated pockets of the Cloud. Too long inside one, you'll die, so be careful where you step.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: I've seen some survive concentration of the Cloud for short periods of time if healthy enough - others were too weak.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Rebreathers, chemical suits... there is no protection against it, it decays all it touches. {Beat, slight anger}I've found fighting it useless.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Low anger, this is frustrating}The Sierra Madre has many... defenses, means of screening guests for illicit or dangerous items. Your arrival here, weaponless, was {emph}not my intention.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: The Casino, this Villa... it takes anything with even a trace of radioactivity, traces of unknown substances... and returns it home. The bunker.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: The process is automated, and the casino itself has other, similar "services." I was unable to find a workaround, except to send others in as tools.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It is the Cloud covering the Villa. The longer you are outside, the more its toxins seep into your system... through the lungs {emph}and the skin.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: It will eat at you the longer you are outside... so wherever you go, move fast, or you'll soon find yourself too weak to move.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It is the Cloud that surrounds the Villa. It shouldn't prove lethal in the time you are here... prolonged exposure would be hazardous, however.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Cold, serious/warning}Fall asleep... and you will not wake up.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Lower, apprehensive... even he's concerned about these guys]
Topic_Name: Is there anyone alive around here?
EN: {Lower, apprehensive... even he's concerned about these guys}Yes... the inhabitants... avoid them if you can, they are difficult to kill.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Be clear, slow in this second half, part of combat "rules"] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: Is there anyone alive around here?
EN: {Be clear, slow in this second half, part of combat "rules"}Whatever has created them, bullets, explosions, energy... it can make them inert for a time, then they seem to crawl back up, restored.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: Needs to be clear these guys will get back up, so slow clarity is important.
Topic_Name: Is there anyone alive around here?
EN: Perhaps it's the Cloud... perhaps something in their physiology.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Emph}I brought you here. {Beat}There are mechanisms in place once the traps across the Mojave are sprung.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: For now, your sole focus should be the Sierra Madre, and how to get inside. Until then, you won't leave alive.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Amused}Unfamiliar with the legend of the Sierra Madre? {Cold, precise}The casino exists. You are one of the few who look upon it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: Where you're standing is the Villa beneath the casino above. {Softer, more to himself}The wreckage... the Villa... lies in the shadow.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Irritated/grumbling throughout}The Villa is a dumping ground of failed construction... Pre-War junk that has aged poorly.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Contemptuous, commanding}I am short on patience. And you are short on time.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Contemptuous, commanding}Ask.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Finality, cold, presses the button}Then you are of no use to me.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I'm not going to help you.
EN: {Cold, imperious}When you came into the bunker, you saw a victim, their head blown off for disobedience.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: I'm not going to help you.
EN: The city is filled with other stories, {emph}many such stories. Is "no" your choice?

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Imperious}That structure you see above the Fountain - the Sierra Madre Casino... {snide}you need to break inside. {Smile}A... heist. {Beat, to himself}Too many years in the making.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Beat, here's the catch] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: {Beat, here's the catch}But to get inside, avoid its traps... you'll need to gather the team. {Beat, frustrated}As I've found, one cannot do it alone.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Cold, clear, these are the "rules"}Around the Villa are three other collars like yours - Collar 8, 12, and 14. Find all three and get them here, to the Fountain. Then, we'll talk more.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Lower, warning] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: {Lower, warning}And should you get any ideas about killing each other and taking the treasure of the Sierra Madre for yourself - a warning.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Emph}All your collars are linked... one of you dies, you {emph}all die. If that's what it takes to make you cooperate, so be it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Collar? What are you talking about?
EN: {Slow taunt, contempt of Pip-Boy}It's like that Pip-Boy on your wrist, except filled with explosives. {Smug, to himself}A little radio of the Old World, just needed some tuning.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: Pip-Boy = Wrist tech that guides the player. AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: Collar? What are you talking about?
EN: Do what I say, and the collar won't go off... refuse, try and run, {emph}disobey me? I'll kill you and find someone else.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Collar? What are you talking about?
EN: There's no escape from here until I let you go. {Quieter, threaten}The sooner you accept your {emph}situation, the better.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Contemptuous, commanding}Are you listening? Good. From now on, when I talk, {emph}listen - and follow my instructions.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain. When player wakes in Villa, Elijah hologram materializes and speaks imperiously.
EN: Play stupid, play clever, make the mistake of saying "no?" That collar on your neck'll go off and take your head with it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: That's all I needed to know.
EN: {Slight smug}Good. {Colder}If {emph}necessary, I will guide you through the Villa's broadcast systems - if you get lost, return here, and I'll direct you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain. "Necessary" delivered as a warning - he doesn't want to be bothered.
Topic_Name: That's all I needed to know.
EN: I've downloaded instructions on an audio log to your Pip-Boy in case you can't read... if you {emph}forget why you're here, let my voice remind you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: That's all I needed to know.
EN: Then go. The Sierra Madre may wait... I will not.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Slower here, doesn't want to reveal too much]
Topic_Name: Who are these people I'm gathering?
EN: {Slower here, doesn't want to reveal too much}One is a trusted ally... obedient, collar or no, {to himself}although the collar helps. {Beat, dismissive/cruel}The other two... well, we'll have to see what the traps caught.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: All right. So find the other three people with bomb collars, bring them back here?
EN: I've downloaded the instructions and markers on your Pip-Boy... in case you forget. {Beat, contempt}And yes, I have access to that device on your wrist.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: All right. So find the other three people with bomb collars, bring them back here?
EN: Get the other three here, after that... I'll have more instructions for you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: All right. So find the other three people with bomb collars, bring them back here?
EN: Do this, I'll let you go. {Beat}I'll let {emph}all of you go.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Radios and speakers can set off my collar?
EN: Yes. But not immediately. {Clear, slow here}You'll hear a beep from your collar's detonator - when you do, step back, scan the area, and find the signal source.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain. Second half needs to be slow and clear here because he's explaining the "rules."
Topic_Name: Radios and speakers can set off my collar?
EN: There are damaged speakers, and shielded ones... the damaged ones you can destroy at range - don't get close, you {emph}can't switch them off like a radio.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Radios and speakers can set off my collar?
EN: The damaged speakers are sparking, ha... hard to miss. The casings are resistant to vandalism - punching or hitting them will {emph}not destroy them.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Building irritation}Yes, music was intended to be broadcast all over the Villa... over time, however, the radio signal has decayed and emits a different frequency.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: Speakers and radios interfere with the bomb collar frequency, and can trigger the detonators... prematurely.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It is an unfortunate side effect, one I did not anticipate. I was unable to calibrate the collars to block the signals - so you'll have to make do.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How are you speaking to me?
EN: {Slight contempt}Confused? {Cold}Don't be. I'm commandeering the hologram technology of the Villa.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: How are you speaking to me?
EN: Numbers, equations, circuits... all can be controlled, provided there's a connection, and the knowledge to use it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How are you speaking to me?
EN: This Villa, the casino... a treasure trove of such devices. The Holograms included.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Someone who followed the call of the Sierra Madre, just as you did. Now that I've found it's more than a story... I intend to take what's inside.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: Maybe that's why you came. Why you followed the Pip-Boy here... and straight into one of my traps. {Beat, cold}Now, this is your reward.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Is there any place safe to rest?
EN: {Quicker, as if should be evident}Anywhere sheltered from the Cloud... inside buildings, tunnels... any place not exposed to the outside air.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: Is there any place safe to rest?
EN: Anything the Cloud has touched has preserved it one way or another... but only the Holograms in the Villa truly remain.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [More matter of fact here, like detailing specs on a car or gun, respects the vending machine tech]
Topic_Name: What are the Vending Machines in the Villa?
EN: {More matter of fact here, like detailing specs on a car or gun, respects the vending machine tech}Assembly stations. Schematics are stored within... dispensers with unlock codes.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: What are the Vending Machines in the Villa?
EN: They use the Chips scattered around as batteries... alloys and raw material embedded in the shell.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: What are the Vending Machines in the Villa?
EN: They resemble the vending machines of the Mojave, but they are crafting devices of tremendous versatility. Once an Old World convenience, now...

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: What are the Vending Machines in the Villa?
EN: ...now, they are a means of survival. Use the Chips to power them. Select from the holographic display, the device will assemble it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Slight admiration as if for beautiful vista]
EN: {Slight admiration as if for beautiful vista}The Cloud is what blankets the sky here... you may smell it in the air, copper and sulfur... burns the lungs and seeps into the skin.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: As for its origins... I am not certain. Pre-War industrial pollutants... something in the Sierra Madre structure...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Contemplative}It is unique across the wasteland... and deadly. It has kept this place preserved since the Great War.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Most Holograms perform specific functions. The Security Holograms, ever since the bombs fell, now perform {emph}their function.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Cold, serious] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: {Cold, serious}They will kill anyone they detect. {Frustrated}They are immune to guns, weapons, EMPs... even energy weapons. Still, they have limitations.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Their design limits their field of view, enough to avoid detection.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Each has an emitter - destroy or disable it, and they cease to be a threat.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Less authoritative here, more reflective/rueful}Still... at least {emph}they still work as intended. Other technology here is more of a threat to you... notably, the Villa's radios and speakers.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Thinking}Ghosts... they fill the Villa. {Beat}More in the Casino... much more.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: They carry out the functions the dead once did. They cannot be harmed... they only perform the same rote tasks until their power dies.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: They are of no consequence - except for the Security Holograms, the ones with the silhouettes of the armored Sierra Madre guards.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Dismissive, throw away the line}A long story. FEV... a virus with an even longer story... it gave birth to the docile one, turned him into a Super Mutant long ago.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Any suggestions for who I should get first?
EN: Yes... {Lower, dismissive, like talking about a mule}Collar 8, the FEV reject, the Super Mutant. He's docile, predictable, and provided he's not starving, should be easy to command.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Frowning, not sure why this is] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: Any suggestions for who I should get first?
EN: {Frowning, not sure why this is}I lost contact with him some time ago... probably after he dragged you here from the trap. Find him, he'll follow you, collar or no.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to find them?
EN: {Authoritative, contempt for RobCo tech}Your piece of RobCo trash will help you, I've ensured it. It can latch on to the signal of the collars...

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to find them?
EN: ...and tune into their frequencies. The bomb collars come with radios embedded in them. You can eavesdrop easily.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to find them?
EN: It was part of their design... to listen in. They can even screen out white noise from the environment to allow greater monitoring.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I've decided I'm not going to help you.
EN: {Cold, imperious}When you came into the bunker, you saw a victim, their head blown off for disobedience.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I've decided I'm not going to help you.
EN: The city is filled with other stories, {emph}many such stories. Is "no" your choice?

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Slightly amused, incredulous, emph on "get"}Hmm! Get here? {Beat, judging}You walked into one of my traps in the Mojave... following the Sierra Madre signal. Now, you're here, with that collar on your neck.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Who's the woman Hologram in the Fountain?
EN: {Throw away line, he doesn't care}I do not know. A Pre-War icon, perhaps. {Beat, back to the matter at hand}It is of no consequence aside from being a circuit I can utilize.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Precise, then superior}It is a Holorifle, a weapon I constructed when I arrived... I have since made superior models - and modifications.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Dismissive] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: {Dismissive}For now, that tool will have to do until you find other weapons... {warning}and I suggest you do, the Holorifle's ammo is limited.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Still, it should serve well enough. I fashioned it from the Holograms of the Villa {beat}and used it against the Villa's... living inhabitants.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Less superior, more didactic in this}This place is well-preserved. Few who came here ever returned. All of the treasures of the Old World lie scattered about, virtually untouched.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: Search, hunt... craft what you can from what you find. The trash of the Pre-War era can keep you alive - food, knives, more. Use them.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Even the Villa's toxins... and the residue it leaves behind... can be shaped into tools and weapons. Gather it as well.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Also... there is one more thing in your possession, a rifle that will keep you alive, as surely as the collar will.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Low anger, this is frustrating}The Sierra Madre has many... defenses, means of screening guests for illicit or dangerous items. Your arrival here, weaponless, was {emph}not my intention.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Irritated, then slow, final in end] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: {Irritated, then slow, final in end}The Casino, this Villa... it takes anything with even a trace of radioactivity, traces of unknown substances... and returns it home. The bunker.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Matter of fact}The process is automated, and the casino itself has other, similar "services." I was unable to find a workaround, except to send others in as tools.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Still... I have not left you defenseless, and the Sierra Madre's security in some respects, can help you if you are resourceful enough.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How many of these victims did you bring here?
EN: {Sharp, frustrated}Too many. {Slower, more frustrated}This place is dangerous... and its quarantine measures, its hazards... have claimed many. Failures upon failures.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: How many of these victims did you bring here?
EN: Do you think I wanted to place collars on you to ensure compliance? No... if robots could have done this, I would've sent them.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How many of these victims did you bring here?
EN: The Sierra Madre is a complicated lock. Cracking it open requires human hands.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Disdain}That is for me to know. You get that far... you'll see for yourself.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Disgust, lower}The ones brought here live on only in what they've left behind, their marks - graffiti on the walls. And victims they've killed.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: Some tried to help... left supplies and healing for others who came. Their reward? They were tracked down, killed by others with baser instincts.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Some of these murderers went as far as to leave traps behind them... turning markers for help into deathtraps for anyone following them.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It killed some of them when they forgot where the traps lay... or when they desperately needed the assistance they had cut others off from.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Theme of the game, clear, cold here]
EN: {Theme of the game, clear, cold here}Because in some respects, breaking in to the Sierra Madre is easier than breaking human instinct. {Beat, explaining}Greed.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: The Villa is filled with corpses. Some killed by the dangers here, some by me. Others... turned on each other.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Once they realized the Sierra Madre could be theirs, they cared nothing for their freedom... their survival... or each other.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So how do I destroy the radios and speakers then?
EN: Gunshots, energy blasts - {more to himself, quick}even spears thrown with great force - can puncture their exterior.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: So how do I destroy the radios and speakers then?
EN: Shielded speakers can't be destroyed at all. You'll need to avoid them or switch them off via a terminal. {Beat, disdain}I... I'll leave the method up to you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: The real work? What was this, a warm-up?
EN: Perhaps you think this is a simple robbery. A cheap casino heist.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain. Cold - "you think this is some dimestore robbery."
Topic_Name: The real work? What was this, a warm-up?
EN: No... this is a heist of the {emph}centuries. We're not plundering the Sierra Madre - we're plundering {emph}history, taking from the Old World itself.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain. Delivery: Die-Hard 1: "I am not a thief - I am an *exceptional* thief."
Topic_Name: The real work? What was this, a warm-up?
EN: It won't let its secrets go easily... not without a fight. I wouldn't expect anything less.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Start Act 2 Quests}I'd suggest taking the FEV reject to his position first... {more to himself, thinking of other dangers}although you may need his brutality and strength elsewhere first.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: As easy as the Villa was to navigate... the outlying areas of the Villa are far more dangerous, thicker with the Ghost People, traps, and toxins.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Use your team as I use you... listen to your collar, watch where you step. You're no use to me dead.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: A display of lights, fireworks... music in the streets, a Pre-War festival to mark the casino's opening. The bombs struck first.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: It is of no consequence, only firing the event is - get the three in position, then travel to your position in Salida del Sol and trigger the Gala.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: After that, the real work begins.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to get to the markers on my map?
EN: {Slow}I've unlocked the West and East gates to Puesta del Sol and Salida del Sol...

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Contempt] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to get to the markers on my map?
EN: {Contempt}...now that you've survived the Villa, I need to get to my position, you don't need me to hold your hand anymore.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to get to the markers on my map?
EN: {Contempt fades a bit}I'll keep monitoring you via the transceivers through the Villa... if I need to offer guidance, I will.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Travel West, toward the Villa Police Station - follow the radio frequency and the alarms.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Thinking, reflective] AUDIO: Floating Hologram Head Projection at Fountain.
EN: {Thinking, reflective}Although there's a great deal of interference at the source. Perhaps that's why I lost contact with him.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: No matter, aside from Collar 8, there should be weapons, armor at the police station. Go West, avoid the Villa inhabitants, bring the mutant back.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: So after your speech about control, now you're going to use the collars like Elijah did?
EN: {Frowns, slow}You know what... you're right. I don't need to use the same methods to kill you, and I shouldn't... it would make me as bad as Elijah is.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: So after your speech about control, now you're going to use the collars like Elijah did?
EN: {Cold, low}All right - forget the proximity frequency, we'll decide this ourselves.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: When we were sneaking, you mentioned Lou... who's Lou?
EN: Lou... ten... ant? Long ago. Smart. {Beat}Gave us all things to do. Like watch. And kill. {Beat}Gone now.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: Confused, then sad. He's referring to "Lou" an old Lieutenant from a previous game, it's a nod to history.
Topic_Name: When we were sneaking, you mentioned Lou... who's Lou?
EN: Miss Lou. Miss the Base. Miss the Church. Don't like here. {Frowns}Don't want to talk about it any more, makes head hurt.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you don't stay here, I'll bring Dog out and leave him here.
EN: And what would that gain you? Are you so eager to slice off your hand to spite your arm?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I don't want Dog to have to deal with this, I prefer to deal with you.
EN: {Slight curious}Really. {Slow}And why is that? Dog is much more... docile. Obedient.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Getting really angry}You think you can figure out what to... {quieter, studying the player, slightly respectful}hnh. Of course you can.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Resolved] {God Voice Very Angry}< God expresses hate for the player and gets into position. >
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: {Resolved}I'll stand at my post. {Then threat comes out}Once you trigger the event... well, we'll see who makes it to the Sierra Madre.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: If that diagram over there holds the details, I can walk Dog through the instructions.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: [FAILED] No... you can barely give me instructions, let alone order Dog. Bark your orders somewhere else.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: We don't really have time for this.
EN: If you don't... then I can't guarantee I'll remain in control long enough to help you. It is... your choice.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: All right, I'll go hunting, see what I can find.
EN: {Quieter, more complacent}Two chunks of meat from their bodies should be enough. Hunt... quietly, so as not to draw more here.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If that's what it takes to make you listen, yes.
EN: So you want me to listen. To obey. No... I can't. Because Dog wouldn't let me. I can already feel him clawing at me.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If that's what it takes to make you listen, yes.
EN: If you want me to remain, then I'll need to stay aware... enough to operate the switches properly.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If that's what it takes to make you listen, yes.
EN: I... we just need to make sure that Dog doesn't surface before that happens. To do that... he'll need to be fed. That makes him stay in the Cage.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: He came this way for a reason, and I want to know why.
EN: [She then slowly shakes her head and draws an "X" in the air.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I don't care. I'd rather reason with someone first than simply kill them.
EN: [She then slowly shakes her head and draws an "X" in the air.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I'm not out to kill anyone, I just want to get out of here.
EN: [Christine looks at you, then shakes her head, points at your collar, then the front gate and shakes her head.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I'd like to know why he did all this first and what's so important about the casino.
EN: [Christine's expression becomes furious, and she raises her hands, draws jagged lines in the air.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I'd like to know why he did all this first and what's so important about the casino.
EN: [She then points at you, then the direction of the casino, and makes the motion of two hands talking to each other.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I'd like to know why he did all this first and what's so important about the casino.
EN: [As one hand continues to talk, she moves the other hand to the wrist, and constricts until the other hand slows, stops talking.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Could always slap a collar on him and let him run into a wall of speakers.
EN: [Christine's expression relaxes slightly, and she nods.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I'm fine with killing the son of a bitch. As long as we can torture him first.
EN: [She nods grimly. She seems satisfied.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She gives a nod. Then another nod, even slower.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Why are you looking for him?
EN: [She wrinkles her face, frowns, and looks angry. She touches her throat, traces the scar with her finger, then points the finger at the casino.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Why are you looking for him?
EN: [She then points at your collars, points at the casino. Then she matches your gaze with a dark expression, then draws a slow line across her throat.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You're looking for the man inside the casino.
EN: [She nods.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You kind of... changed there for a second.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE}[She looks like she's about to shake her head, stops, and then puts her hand over her eyes and squints, as if staring in the distance.]

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You kind of... changed there for a second.
EN: Don't ignore me - your whole body language changed there.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You kind of... changed there for a second.
EN: [FAILED] [She glares at you a moment, then slowly shakes her head.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Um, do you want to talk about it, or...?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] [She looks like she's about to shake her head, stops, and then puts her hand over her eyes and squints, as if staring in the distance.]

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Um, do you want to talk about it, or...?
EN: No, before we go any further, I need to know what the problem is.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Um, do you want to talk about it, or...?
EN: [FAILED] [She glares at you a moment, then slowly shakes her head.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You really want to get to him, don't you.
EN: [She ignores you for a second, still staring at the casino. Then she glances at you, and her face and stance relax slightly.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You really want to get to him, don't you.
EN: [She points at her collar, then the casino with an irritated look. She then folds her arms and raises an eyebrow.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine looks at you, frowns. Then glances at the casino, her eyes narrowed. She stops breathing for a second, as if holding it in.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You can still do numbers and calculations.
EN: [She nods.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You can still do math, that's good to hear.
EN: [She nods, smiles.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Why... would someone remove your ability to write, or...
EN: [SUCCEEDED] [She nods, slowly, and then makes the motion of typing and drawing X's and lines in the air, and then gives a thumbs up.]

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why... would someone remove your ability to write, or...
EN: That's a specific form of brain surgery using electrodes. Pre-War.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Why... would someone remove your ability to write, or...
EN: [FAILED] [She looks distant... then slowly shakes her head.]

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why... would someone remove your ability to write, or...
EN: That's a rather specific form of operation.

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She shakes her head... then stops, as if thinking.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Something to do with the surgery.
EN: [She pauses, then draws a jagged symbol like electricity in the air, then puts on an odd, staring face.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Something to do with the surgery.
EN: [She keeps the blank face for a second, then slowly blinks, looks around. She looks at her hands, shakes them, then lets them go limp.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: This nodding, frowning, pointing you do is wearing me out.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] [Christine frowns, then pauses and traces one of the scars on her head with her finger.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: This nodding, frowning, pointing you do is wearing me out.
EN: [She then makes a motion as if picking up a pencil, tries to write, then shakes her head.]

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: This nodding, frowning, pointing you do is wearing me out.
EN: Can't you communicate some other way? Can you write?

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: This nodding, frowning, pointing you do is wearing me out.
EN: [FAILED] [Christine nods, frowns, then points at you, then points West. Then she glares at you.]

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Go to the Fountain and wait for me there.
EN: {Eager, a little quiet}Master, Dog waited a long time... brought you many people. If Dog finds more, will bring them to the Fountain, Dog promises.

Speaker: Dog
EN: Yes, Master. Dog waited a long time... brought you many people. Dog will follow.

Speaker: Dog
EN: Already have a Dog with you... Dog will meet you at the Fountain. {Slightly too eager}Maybe find food on the way.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Shut up, reject, and give me the key. Now.
EN: {Bad Node: Cringing}Yes, Master. Here, Dog sorry, Dog... just... {Beat}just let Dog out of the cage. Don't want to be here any longer.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Just give me the key - you want out of the cage, don't you?
EN: {Good Node, slightly confused}Yes, Master... Master sounds different, quieter. Master... {Beat}Dog doesn't want to be in the cage any more. Dog will be good this time, Dog promises.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Now that you are awake, Master wants you to listen, Dog.
EN: {Nods, quiet}Master, Dog is here. What does Master want?

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: I need your obedience. First, I'm going to show you a trick.
EN: Does Master want Dog to fetch someone? {Beat, quiet}Dog will hunt down whoever you want, bring them here.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Dog, hidden on you is the key. Find it, and toss it to me.
EN: Dog... Dog doesn't have a... hnh. Here it is. {Frowns}Dog... Dog didn't know it was there. {Frowns, suspicious}How did it get there?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Very good. Yes... it's another layer of white noise to ensure privacy. Unfortunately, it's also acted as a dinner bell for the residents.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside.
EN: As long as the holographic greeter outside is active, however, I can get by them... the Holograms fascinate them. Ghost-worship, perhaps.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside.
EN: ...and the alarm sound outside helps as well. Your doing?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Surprised they could hear you over the alarm bell outside.
EN: [FAILED] Yes... interesting that. {To himself, irritated by Ghost People outside}More like a dinner bell to some.

Speaker: God
EN: The... inhabitants of the Villa. They are difficult to kill. {Pause}They need to be chopped apart, hacked on the ground... disintegrated, if you can.

Speaker: God
EN: They are difficult to kill... but not to devour. {Beat}And Dog is always hungry.

Speaker: God
EN: If he is with you, when they fall, he will fall on them, end them. If I am with you... fighting will be far more difficult.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: In that case, I will bring him along, I don't need you.
EN: {Laughs}And so... greed, practical or otherwise, has its day.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Even if Dog is more helpful, we can manage.
EN: {Chuckles, amused}I am not sure you belong here. No, you don't belong here.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Even if Dog is more helpful, we can manage.
EN: Yet... {appraising player}you came this far. And I'm not interested in remaining here any longer. I'll unlock the cage.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I can't convince you I'm not here for the Sierra Madre or the Old Man, so I'll prove it.
EN: {Frowns}Prove it... how? Words are worthless.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I have the power to let Dog out of his cage. I'm going to prove it by not doing it.
EN: {Studying the player}Hnh. No... no, you're not. {Confused here, slow, since flies in the face of reason}Even though Dog's more docile... easier to control.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Questioning] He's confused, echoing player's line again. The player's got a gun to him, yet not pulling the trigger - maybe the player's good people?
Topic_Name: I have the power to let Dog out of his cage. I'm going to prove it by not doing it.
EN: {Questioning}You may regret this. This place... this place is where creatures like Dog can survive. The people that fill its streets...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I have the power to let Dog out of his cage. I'm going to prove it by not doing it.
EN: He is as vicious, more vicious than them. His hunger can help you more than I can. When I am in control... this shell is difficult to... fight in.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Calm down. Follow me, willingly, I won't do it.
EN: {Echoing the player}No, you wouldn't. If you did, you won't escape this place alive. I'd shatter every one of your limbs to splinters and leave you here.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: First line is echoing the player, not saying no.
Topic_Name: Calm down. Follow me, willingly, I won't do it.
EN: You think I'm afraid of your collar exploding, killing us? No, I'll leave you breathing, then keep walking until {emph}my collar goes cold.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Calm down. Follow me, willingly, I won't do it.
EN: I'll prop your broken body in view of the Sierra Madre so you can see what you came to steal... forever out of reach as you die.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Goodbye, whoever you are... I'm going to let Dog out of his cage.
EN: No! No, no, don't! I'll make you suffer for this, I promise you.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Goodbye, whoever you are... I'm going to let Dog out of his cage.
EN: {End Bad Node}Although it may not matter... I suspect the Sierra Madre will be reward enough for ones like you.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: What if we go after the Old Man together?
EN: No... I don't trust you. Even if you're not working with him, you'll fall into the same trap he did.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: What if we go after the Old Man together?
EN: {Slow taunting}You may think you can take your revenge... that'll change. You'll start thinking there's a way to have it all.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I want my freedom, too. You think I like having this collar on me?
EN: {Low, quiet}They all wanted their freedom at first. Then... they realized they could get inside the Sierra Madre.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I want my freedom, too. You think I like having this collar on me?
EN: After that, their freedom wasn't important any more. They couldn't let go, just like the Old Man. So you say you want your freedom...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I want my freedom, too. You think I like having this collar on me?
EN: No... even if you feel that way, it won't last. You'll forget, get greed-blind, and you'll turn.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I can play his voice, yes. I have an audio log from him on my Pip-Boy.
EN: {Pauses}You... {snarling}don't play it. {Snarls}If you do, I'll find a way to get out of the cage, end you. I'll murder you, crush your arms and legs until...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If he hears the Old Man's voice, he'll do what the Old Man says.
EN: {Suspicious}Dog... obeys. Yes. {Wary, this was unexpected}Why... do you have some means of contacting the Old Man?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I could just tell Dog he has the key.
EN: {Frowns, slightly hesitant}Yes... you could. {Recovers}And once he was out, all starving and hungry... what do you think he would do then?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I could just tell Dog he has the key.
EN: {Warning}Be careful what cage you open, because he won't go back in it without a fight. He'll tear you apart, he won't care if it kills you both.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: The key's in there with you - and Dog.
EN: {Cruel, laughing}Yes, but Dog doesn't know that. We don't share everything. Sometimes it's a blessing... sometimes... it causes difficulties.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: The key's in there with you - and Dog.
EN: Now I think it's a blessing, it keeps you on that side of the cage. Now... you go fetch. Find your master, bring him here so we can talk.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I could order Dog to come with me. I bet he'd obey.
EN: {Laughs}Dog? You're not talking to him now, are you? No, even if you could drag Dog out of his cage, you still couldn't get him out of {emph}this cage.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I could order Dog to come with me. I bet he'd obey.
EN: {Smug}I put him here for a reason... if he could have escaped, he would have. So here he stays.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you don't come with me, he'll set off our collars - yours and mine.
EN: Then I still win. I'd rather die in this cell than have Dog follow him any longer, follow his orders, his commands, desperate for recognition.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you don't come with me, he'll set off our collars - yours and mine.
EN: The Old Man... he has the need to hold on, to the past, to the Madre... I'd rather be free, let go of this shell, than have it cage me any longer.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] They were here when I arrived... so I made use of them, in a manner of speaking. More their... voices, really.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: Smug, eviler, clever-er at the end. He's explaining how clever he was, and he can't help it. "manner of speaking" = play on words.
Topic_Name: Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?
EN: These collars... they don't just track us. You can eavesdrop on them as well. Tune to a frequency, and you can hear everything someone is saying.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?
EN: {Slightly amused}So perhaps it's a good thing that Dog swallowed his collar. Anyone listening would find it difficult to hear past the... digestion.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?
EN: These radios, were you using them for signal interference?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why did you surround yourself with all these radios?
EN: [FAILED] I was afraid Dog would get lonely. The voices, as static and whispering as they are... are still company.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] The key? Why it's the Old Man, the one who brought us here.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?
EN: I hid the key on me so Dog wouldn't know... I just need the Old Man to show up, so he and I can talk.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?
EN: If Dog was in control when the Old Man appeared... well, he would just do whatever he commanded, as always. And I can't have that.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?
EN: You wouldn't have locked yourself in there without some sort of key to let you out.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?
EN: [FAILED] It's close, safe, as you know.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So... you're locked in there? Where's the key?
EN: [FAILED] It's close, safe. I did lock myself in, after all.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Wait. So you... or Dog... doesn't know the key is on him?
EN: {Sarcastic}Dog and I don't share... everything. What {emph}I know, {emph}he doesn't.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Wait. So you... or Dog... doesn't know the key is on him?
EN: What he knows... what little he knows... I don't. For example, your arrival is a surprise. I wished {emph}that I could have remembered, I'm sure Dog knew.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Wait. So you... or Dog... doesn't know the key is on him?
EN: {To himself, angry}And when he's feeding, well... I sometimes have to find out about it later. Now all there is to do is wait for my intended guest.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you locked him... you... in, what if you couldn't get out?
EN: {Malicious, slightly smug}Oh, I have the key, always did. {Disgusted}Hid it on the chain behind my neck before Dog came bursting out, eating everything he could.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you locked him... you... in, what if you couldn't get out?
EN: Wanted to make sure whoever came to fetch Dog spoke to {emph}me first, got within reach. Instead... I get you.

Speaker: God
EN: {Taunting}Heard the call of the Sierra Madre, just like you did... {emph}exactly the same way.

Speaker: God
EN: {Slow, reflective here}Finds out it's more than a story, {sarcasm bleeds in}comes to this shining poisonous grail, this jewel of the desert.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Anger comes back] More contemplative, shows a non-prick side.
EN: {Anger comes back}Dog knows him more than I do. Dog's always nodding, always obeying him, because he's weak and hungry and greedy for master's affection.

Speaker: God
EN: {More reflective than normal, not malicious}The Old Man... this "Elijah," tried to hold the sun in his hands, arrogance, was cast down for it. Icarus' crime was to fly too high, Elijah...

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Anger comes back] More telling a story here than being a prick, he's chewing this over slowly as he speaks.
EN: {Anger comes back}Elijah wanted to bring the sun down to {emph}him. Hnh! {Snorts}Arrogance.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I don't remember, only woke up when my Pip-Boy went active.
EN: {Thinking}Must have already been in the cage... already had the collar in me. You're lucky Dog didn't devour you... otherwise, we'd be closer than we are now.

Speaker: God
EN: I don't remember you... that isn't surprising. What is... is that it was when Dog was out of his cage... free, hungry.

Speaker: God
EN: He knows not to eat anything he catches in the traps... after that, however... so he dragged you here, you got spared.

Speaker: God
EN: {Thinking}Dog must have fed {emph}after you arrived... once he was fed, that allowed me out of the cage, and put him inside. {Beat, curious}Do you remember how long you were out?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So you know the way back?
EN: The way back doesn't matter... try to leave, try to disobey, and your collar ends the journey faster than you can say, "begin again."

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So you know the way back?
EN: You're clever, you'd be able to find a way back if you left the Villa. Dog can... I can find the way back, if "back" is where I even wanted to go.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: So you know the way back?
EN: Until the Old Man lets you go, you're going nowhere. This beautiful paradise, with all its toxins and death... it's home.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: You brought me here to the Villa.
EN: Me? You think I want to haul bodies around the wastes like a Brahmin at the whip? {Snarling, spitting}No, Dog does it, when the Old Man says fetch, Dog fetches.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: You brought me here to the Villa.
EN: You were in a man-trap, and Dog made his rounds, and dragged you here. When, I don't know. But... it must have been... recent. Before the cage.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: This Old Man, what do you know about him?
EN: Elijah. Human, weak like all of you are. Feeling age circling him like starved dogs, howling for blood.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: This Old Man, what do you know about him?
EN: To me, he reeks of age and failure. And madness. {Beat}To me, he is simply the "Old Man." To Dog, he is "Master." His name, meaningless.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: This Old Man, what do you know about him?
EN: Running out of years, hopes and dreams running through his withered hands like sand from the Big Empty... and scorched by the sun.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why do you say I'm the same as the Old Man?
EN: {Disgust, player doesn't get it}You're not him anymore than I'm Dog. But that collar around your neck...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why do you say I'm the same as the Old Man?
EN: ...you're an extension of the Old Man's grasp, clumsy, perhaps, but a tool, yes. And once you get acclimated to the Sierra Madre...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why do you say I'm the same as the Old Man?
EN: ...then you'll feel the same overpowering hunger the Old Man does. And then you'll {emph}be him, not just his hand.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Do you know how I got here?
EN: {Amused}Of course I know. {Snarling}Even if I don't see it happen - down in the cage, I hear echoes of the footfalls, the click of the collars.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Furious] Slower at the end, snapping like traps locking into place.
Topic_Name: Do you know how I got here?
EN: {Furious}Every time I see one of you, I know exactly how you got here - you couldn't help yourselves, anymore than Dog can help himself.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Do you know how I got here?
EN: {Accusing}You heard the voice, the promise, and then you walked right into one of the Old Man's traps. Then... then Dog comes for you, drags you here.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Maybe you shouldn't go around shoving Old World tech in your stomach.
EN: {Sneers}As if I had a choice. Sometimes instinct takes over, and that's when {emph}I go into the cage. {Beat, superior}It's like curiosity that way.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Maybe you shouldn't go around shoving Old World tech in your stomach.
EN: {Taunting}After all, you wouldn't have put that collar on by choice... perhaps it was {emph}your curiosity that caused that hand to close on your neck.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: How the hell did you... or whoever... eat one of these collars?
EN: {Frowns}They... detach. When segmented, they look like nothing more than metallic Radscorpions... and if they're attached to neck flesh, warm, red...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: How the hell did you... or whoever... eat one of these collars?
EN: {Angry}Dog doesn't {emph}care what's on the body he's crushing in his hands, he'll mangle it, twist it, make it fit until he's full.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Quiet] Should spit out his frustrations at the end.
Topic_Name: How the hell did you... or whoever... eat one of these collars?
EN: {Quiet}Dog can't help himself... hungry... greedy. And now the collar's inside, alive again. And we're trapped here until it goes cold.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If that collar inside you is active, I didn't switch it on.
EN: {Suspicious}Really. Yet it led you here, to me. And now you're here, and it's burning a hole in my guts. Maybe it's crying for its owner.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you weren't expecting me, who were you waiting for?
EN: Don't play stupid, I already have to mind {emph}one child. {Beat}You {emph}must have figured it out by now.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you weren't expecting me, who were you waiting for?
EN: {To himself}The Old Man obsessed with the Sierra Madre... riddled with greed. {Beat, predatory}Hoped you might be him when I woke up. All you are is his hand...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If you weren't expecting me, who were you waiting for?
EN: ...you're the same kind of greed. Followed the radio, the broadcast, and now you're here, all confused. Not for long. You'll figure it out.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I need to get you out of there.
EN: No... no, I don't think so. Even in here, I have more control than you do.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: Malicious here, hates that the player just tried to give him orders.
Topic_Name: I need to get you out of there.
EN: I'm not leaving until the one who controls the collars shows... not his voice, not his hand, not his lackey... him.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I need to get you out of there.
EN: And when he comes to see me, we'll settle things. So go on, go back to your master, tell him I'm waiting for him. Dog may follow him - I won't.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why did you lock yourself in the cage?
EN: No... why did {emph}I lock him in the cage. {Beat, malicious}I locked him in because I could feel him... getting hungry again. There wasn't much time.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why did you lock yourself in the cage?
EN: If Dog roams, he gets into trouble... eats things he shouldn't, listens to others he shouldn't... so he's safer in here. We're safer in here.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why did you lock yourself in the cage?
EN: I hoped if I locked him in here... the one he obeys would come for him. {Disgust}Instead, I get you.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I was looking for someone with a collar like mine. Where is your collar?
EN: {Angry}It's close. Closer than I'd like... {frustrated}Dog's been into things, needs to think before he eats, chew before he swallows. He's... eager that way.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: Pissed here because Dog ruined all his plans for escape by swallowing the collar.
Topic_Name: I was looking for someone with a collar like mine. Where is your collar?
EN: Now the collar's a part of me. Inside. {Slow, feeling it in his gut}I can feel its electronic heartbeat, clicking and burning down below... {thinking}like before.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Suspicious] He's analyzing this, then he realizes it feels different than it did, which is bad.
Topic_Name: I was looking for someone with a collar like mine. Where is your collar?
EN: {Suspicious}It was cold and heavy before going in the cage... {suspicious}now you're here, and it's pulling and kicking again, tugging like a leash. Interesting.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I can't leave until we get through this.
EN: Of course you can't. This cage is locked tight... from you and the Old Man.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: So the Gala Event was triggered at least once?
EN: Uh-huh. Master ordered it. "Take places." Then... {frowns}Master went away. {Starts getting quieter}Left Dog... Dog in cage.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: So the Gala Event was triggered at least once?
EN: Casino open long time ago, not sure when... voice keeps putting Dog in cage. Haven't seen Master since, only hear voice on your arm and from walls.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Um... do you want to talk about it?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Slightly wary, warming up}The lights were pretty. In the sky. Pointed at casino. {Beat, like wonder}And the casino opened up.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Um... do you want to talk about it?
EN: Dog, think back to the lights, the pretty ones.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Um... do you want to talk about it?
EN: [FAILED] {Clams up}Uh-uh. Dog... Dog wants to stop talking now.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: This is important - do you remember what happened exactly?
EN: {Clams up, quiet}Dog can't remember. {Beat, quiet}Don't want to go, can't make him stay there.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: We need to get you to the Gala Event. Get you to your place.
EN: Dog... Dog has heard that before. Was there pretty lights? {Frowns, gets a little more focused}There... were things to pull? Hard to pull, but Dog did. And... {quiet}a cage.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: Dog, slowly remembering he triggered the Gala Event once already, and bad memories associated with it.
Topic_Name: We need to get you to the Gala Event. Get you to your place.
EN: ...and Dog was hungry there. Dog... {frowns}was someone else there, with Dog. Then... {pained, doesn't want to remember the girl's screams}then there was noise, then... lights... and streets... screamed.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: Recalling what happened with the girl he was trapped with, tearing her apart.
Topic_Name: We need to get you to the Gala Event. Get you to your place.
EN: ...Dog doesn't want to go to cage. It's inside Dog now, Dog can see the cage, hear the noises. {Beat}The way to casino... it'll hurt you. Inside.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE}Very good. Yes... it's another layer of white noise to ensure privacy. Unfortunately, it's also acted as a dinner bell for the residents.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though.
EN: As long as the holographic greeter outside is active, however, I can get by them... the Holograms fascinate them. Ghost-worship, perhaps.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though.
EN: You're blocking the eavesdropping with the alarm outside, too. Nice.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: I guess... the alarm outside sure is a racket, though.
EN: [FAILED] {DUPE}Yes... interesting that. {To himself, irritated by Ghost People outside}More like a dinner bell to some.

Speaker: Dog
EN: Hnnh-hnn.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Nods}Yes, Master.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Nods}Nnnh-Hnnn.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and trigger the switches.
EN: {Complaining}Dog doesn't understand... {to himself}too hungry, hard to hear words... {slightly petulant and evil here}Master, when can Dog {emph}feed.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: [Quiet, this is a little creepy in its hopefulness] < Dog complains about being hungry and doesn't understand what to do when the player is asking him to trigger the Gala Event. >
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and trigger the switches.
EN: {Quiet, this is a little creepy in its hopefulness}If Dog was fed like last time, Dog would listen. If the feeding was quiet.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: [Slightly fearful] Dog is referring a "bad" thing he did. Deep down, wants to do it again. He devoured a girl needing his help, couldn't, wouldn't stop himself.
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and trigger the switches.
EN: {Slightly fearful}Maybe voice could make Dog stay, Dog not want to be in cage, Dog want to be free, find Master.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Snarling, clutching ears at start after unpleasant noise]
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and trigger the switches.
EN: {Snarling, clutching ears at start after unpleasant noise}Nnnh... getting tired of hearing your orders. {Slow, appraising his health}Dog's clawing at the cage, hungrier than usual.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Narrows eyes, suspicious] {God voice}< God is hungry and doesn't want to turn back into Dog. He wants to know why he should stay here instead of find food. >
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and trigger the switches.
EN: {Narrows eyes, suspicious}You must {emph}need something, I can see it in your eyes. {Glancing around}The Gala... of course. How could I forget?

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Slow, taunting] Realizes the player summoned him to pull a lever to trigger Gala.
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and trigger the switches.
EN: {Slow, taunting}If you want me to... heel... if you want Dog to obey, then he'll need to be fed, {beat, a little quieter, not happy about what happened}like last time.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Those scars on your body - where did you get them?
EN: {Shrugs, a little sad/sheepish}Hurt self. Hurt makes the voice go away... it doesn't like pain.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Those scars on your body - where did you get them?
EN: {Pissed}Dog doesn't like pain, either, but keeps voice quiet, so Dog will hurt self until voice dies. Dog hurt self enough, voice go away, never come back.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Can you tell me how you got to the Sierra Madre?
EN: {Confused}Here? Followed voice in air, then here... here as long as can remember. {Hushes voice a bit}Don't like this place... hard to find things to eat sometimes.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Can you tell me how you got to the Sierra Madre?
EN: {To himself}Better than the cage. {Frowns, petulant/angry}Dog doesn't {emph}like being locked up. Voice in air didn't say anything about a cage and nothing to eat.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Do you know how to wake him up?
EN: Sometimes when Dog gets tired. Or eats too much, gets full. Sometimes... {frowns}when Dog goes to the cage... then voice wakes up.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Do you know how to wake him up?
EN: {Getting irritated, pissed}The voice locks Dog in when it comes up, always trying to keep Dog from food. Voice did it at the cage where you found me. {Happy, draw this out}Then Master came.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Hushed}Other voice... don't wake him up. When voice wakes up, Dog goes to sleep and voice climbs up in Dog's head.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {To himself}The voice puts Dog in places... puts him in cages and locks him in.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Quiet, bad dog}Lost it. Got hungry. {Beat}Made the other voice mad, madder than it ever was, mad enough to lock Dog up.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: I want to hear more about the Master.
EN: {Brightening up}He takes care of Dog. He tells Dog what to do. Told Dog to come here, put collars on people.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: I want to hear more about the Master.
EN: Sometimes people fight. Dog holds them until they go quiet, don't make any noise. {Beat}If collars don't fit or go too quiet... {shrugs}find others for Master.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: I want to hear more about the Master.
EN: {Strangely intense}Master makes the other voice go away - the other voice hates Master, Dog can feel it. Master's voice is like pain, protects Dog.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Pleased, agreeing with player here}Master always feed Dog if not in cage. Master lets Dog do what Dog wants. {Grumbling}Not like other voice in cage. Always mad with Dog, shouting at him.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Where does the voice come from?
EN: {Slight anger, frustration}Don't know where other voice come from. Wish would go away. Always trying to stop Dog, caging Dog.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Where does the voice come from?
EN: {Thinking}Voice started talking not long ago, Dog think... was always there. Start talking when Master showed up? {Irritated}Making Dog sleep, go to cage.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Where does the voice come from?
EN: Voice hates Master. It okay... {Curious}voice {emph}always hide when Master around, go quiet, watch Master as he does things. Voice scared of Master, Dog thinks.

Speaker: Dog
EN: All gone. {Beat, a little sadder}All gone. {Beat, slightly stronger}It better now that found {emph}new Master.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Slightly evil}New Master tells Dog what to do, rewards Dog, like old Master. Dog goes get people, drag them here... like vat. Dog knows how to do that.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Deliver this gruesomely}If people fight, Dog hit them until they stop. And if more than one, Dog can eat them, so Dog hunts hard for as {emph}many as he can find.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Why you want to look like ground?
EN: When put it on, hard to see. Hard to see... Dog was told not to be seen then. Same as now, except different.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: Dumb story time, cont. Getting confused here. He's remembering his stealth orders back West, where mutants were spies.
Topic_Name: Why you want to look like ground?
EN: Dog and others... had to hide in Base. And Church. The Master was there. Master was... {frowns}spoke like many people. Smart. Like Lou-Lieutenant.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: [Remembering back, slight tender] "Lieutenant," occasionally called Lou by the slower troops. Which was most of them.
Topic_Name: Why you want to look like ground?
EN: {Remembering back, slight tender}Dog misses the Church. {Beat}When got dark, no people, Dog could sit on floor and look up at ceiling. {Beat}Could... take off wrist-collar then.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Nods}Is true. Dog wore it right on his hand, where bear trap is now... he thinks.

Speaker: God
EN: {Irritated}More? Don't push your luck.

Speaker: God
EN: {Malicious, taunting}You're a brave one. Sure you're ready for the answers?

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Eager}Dog eats whatever he can catch. Sometimes they run, but Dog is strong, moves fast.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Sad}Sometimes... makes voice mad when I eat... {brightens up, "but..."}Master doesn't mind.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Frowns, getting complicated}Dog hears many voices... one in air. {Scared, thinking about God}The... other one. {Brightens up a bit}And Master. Master is the nicest. {Frowns}Gets mean, mad sometimes. But lets Dog feed.

Speaker: Dog
EN: Master was quiet for a long time until Dog heard him on your arm... {frowns, confused}did you eat him? {Sympathizes with player for eating a human being}Dog gets hungry, too. {Quiet}Being hungry makes the voice... mad.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Me hear voice, too? Then got here, bad place.
EN: {Nods gravely}Dog trapped here, too. This place not like West. Air like copper wire. Gut heavy, hurts, beeps sometimes.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: In this sequence of nodes, Dog and a dumb character are sharing info. It's only available for dumb characters.
Topic_Name: Me hear voice, too? Then got here, bad place.
EN: Back West... in bone cities... {Beat, slight wonder}Dog wore a collar on wrist, turned him into color of ground, turned him into color of sky.

Speaker: Dog
EN: Dog is getting tired, Master. {Grumbling, slight threat}When can Dog eat?

Speaker: Dog
EN: Too much talking makes Dog's head hurt. {Beat}Getting hungry.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Your name is carved on your chest. Is that part of it?
EN: Yes... {frowns}no... don't know what the word means, everyone says the same, except the voice. {Hushed, frightened}The voice says it backward.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Is that why you have a bear trap locked on your arm?
EN: Dog put his hand in it, hurts. Made the voice go away, now can't get it off. Don't want it off, hurt keeps voice sleeping... {angrier, yet pleased}bleeding.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Is that why you have a bear trap locked on your arm?
EN: {Confiding in player}It also keeps {emph}others quiet, too. Dog hits them with metal bear teeth until their voices stop, makes Master's voice come back.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: <Lie> Just... stay here in the courtyard, I'll go get food.
EN: {Suspicious}All right... for a moment there, I thought... hnh. I'll wait here then, come back when you've found a carcass. Or three.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If I bring food, will that calm Dog down?
EN: It always does... makes him sleepier. Weaker. Easier to keep out of trouble. As for the type of food...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: If I bring food, will that calm Dog down?
EN: Make sure it isn't struggling, if you can. {To himself, rueful, irritated}It's hard enough to choke down half of what I suspect he eats. And make sure it's not a bomb collar.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Getting really angry}You think you can figure out what to... {quieter, studying the player, slightly respectful}hnh. Of course you can.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Resolved] {God Voice Very Angry}< God expresses hate for the player and gets into position. >
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: {Resolved}I'll stand at my post. {Then threat comes out}Once you trigger the event... well, we'll see who makes it to the Sierra Madre.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: If that diagram over there holds the details, I can walk Dog through the instructions.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Yeah, well, I'll make Dog help me. Can't be hard to figure all this wire stuff out.
EN: [FAILED] No... you can barely give me instructions, let alone order Dog. Bark your orders somewhere else.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Have orders for you - for going, staying, all that.
EN: {Nods}Dog is listening.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Could I find my way back?
EN: Maybe. Not sure you could find way back once leave. Dog has to smell and hunt for path back here sometimes... {frowns}Cloud keep moving.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: Last part - "finding road back is hard, buddy."
Topic_Name: Could I find my way back?
EN: It okay... no one {emph}ever leave except Dog... and Dog not want to leave. {Beat, drops this more like threat}You here until Master lets you go.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Do you know the way back?
EN: Might find way back if Master lets you go. If he not want you to go, he makes head red spray. {Thinking, to himself}Then Dog has to find another one.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: [Confused, never thought about anyone leaving before]
Topic_Name: Do you know the way back?
EN: {Confused, never thought about anyone leaving before}To leave...? Go through gate, walk. Hard to find way, Dog can do it, too hard for most to come here. {It's why...}Why so quiet in streets.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Affirmative}Dog fetches. Dragged you here... Dog thinks. You not struggle like others. Trap makes you sleep, make your voice go to cage.

Speaker: Dog
EN: Dog doing what he was told. Tried to catch as many as he can, can eat the others.

Speaker: Dog
EN: No eat you, though. Master talk through you, like voice inside Dog. {Beat}Dog missed hearing Master, not hear Master for long time.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: If the casino already opened, what are we doing here?
EN: {Shrugs}Don't know. {Beat}Dog keep bringing people here.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: So Master vanished around that time.
EN: {Nods}Master went away until you show up with him on your arm.

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Dog, do you know why you have to go to the position on the map?
EN: {Confused}Hard to pull things...? Dog has to pull very, very hard to... {beat, slow fear/curious}are we going there?

Speaker: Dog
Topic_Name: Dog, do you know why you have to go to the position on the map?
EN: Dog not want to stay and pull things... hard to do... {quieter}and cage there.

Speaker: God
EN: {Snarl}Ask him. Or better, don't. It wouldn't be an interesting conversation, much like this one.

Speaker: God
EN: {Taunting}Heard the call of the Sierra Madre, just like you did... {emph}exactly the same way.

Speaker: God
EN: {Slow, reflective here}Finds out it's more than a story, {sarcasm bleeds in}comes to this shining poisonous grail, this jewel of the desert.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Anger comes back] More contemplative, shows a non-prick side.
EN: {Anger comes back}Dog knows him more than I do. Dog's always nodding, always obeying him, because he's weak and hungry and greedy for master's affection.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: {Global}Did getting hit in the head cause you to start acting this way?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE: Slightly wary, player's onto something}Trauma... yes, in a manner of speaking.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Global}Did getting hit in the head cause you to start acting this way?
EN: You have multiple personality disorder. Some trauma caused this?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: {Global}Did getting hit in the head cause you to start acting this way?
EN: [FAILED] {DUPE: Taunting, playing games}No... sometimes it simply wakes voices up.

Speaker: God
EN: The instinct is stronger than me. Dog is stronger than me. He's just a child... he knows when he does wrong, he just can't help himself.

Speaker: God
EN: I don't know when I first spoke, or when I first started thinking for myself, it was so long ago. I... slept for a long time... before...

Speaker: God
EN: ...I want to believe I was the one in control. Once. I don't know anymore. Then Dog got a new Master. A new voice. And I woke up, to protect him.

Speaker: God
EN: He's my brother - kin. Without him, I wouldn't exist. Maybe I was nothing more than his conscience, trying to rein him in. Useless.

Speaker: God
EN: I... I just need him to show restraint, let go of the needs, the hungers. Ease the burden... just once, so I can have my thoughts to myself.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Does not being in control bother you so much?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Starts weakening here, tired}I've watched over Dog for so long. Tried to stop him from... hurting others, killing others, {frustrated anger}quiet that mindless howling instinct of his.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Does not being in control bother you so much?
EN: He doesn't understand, he has the brain of a child... he knows when he does wrong, he just can't help himself.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Does not being in control bother you so much?
EN: You're trying to protect Dog. Having Elijah control him, hurt him - you want to protect him.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Does not being in control bother you so much?
EN: [FAILED] No... because all I need to do is bide my time. I'll settle this... myself, as I always planned.

Speaker: God
EN: {Echoing, emph}Do anything? {Hurt and frustration coming through}Me... me, Dog puts in the cage, hurts himself to try and drown out my voice, when all I want to do...

Speaker: God
EN: ...aah... hrrr, never mind, useless. Finally had to start fighting back, screaming on my own. Had to take matters into my own hands, lock Dog up.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: What does Elijah make Dog do that angers you so much?
EN: Gather others, drag them here... fetch, like an animal... and hurt them if they resist.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: What does Elijah make Dog do that angers you so much?
EN: Dog doesn't even blink, even hear their cries when he's twisted their arms full circle... fragile things, screaming on the ground...

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: Hates this, hates what Elijah makes Dog do.
Topic_Name: What does Elijah make Dog do that angers you so much?
EN: To listen to him... commanding Dog... to hurt others... and Dog just nods, eager and willing to serve.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Sounds like it makes you mad.
EN: Mad? Mad doesn't even begin to describe... there's not a {emph}word for the hate I feel inside. It's consuming... twists every thought to red.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Sounds like it makes you mad.
EN: {Snarling}After all that's laid ruin to the world... again and again, I thought at last, we could be free... thought Dog could be free.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Sounds like it makes you mad.
EN: No... no, the world's always got another cage, waiting, keeping everything you want... just out of reach.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Well... true enough. Sure uses the word "Master" a lot.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Slow, thoughtful}The "Master" - Elijah... reminds Dog of someone from long ago. His leader, commander. Commanders.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: "Commanders" b/c Master had multiple personality disorder as well.
Topic_Name: Well... true enough. Sure uses the word "Master" a lot.
