EN: The Master was a strong personality... personalities as well. Dog is slavish, was conditioned to serve the Master until death.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Well... true enough. Sure uses the word "Master" a lot.
EN: The Old Man... Elijah merely came along and opened that door in Dog's mind. Now Dog does whatever the Old Man wants.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Well... true enough. Sure uses the word "Master" a lot.
EN: Why did you put emphasis on the word "Master" before?

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Well... true enough. Sure uses the word "Master" a lot.
EN: [FAILED] Habit. Conditioning. It doesn't matter.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Why does that make him go away?
EN: Dog is afraid of me as long as {emph}the Master isn't around.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: {God}We need to discuss tactics - and positioning.
EN: {Low, threatening}Orders - for me. This should be good.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: How do you switch back and forth between voices?
EN: All it takes is the right... command. Whenever Dog hears the... {corrects self}his Master giving orders, I go back in the cage.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: How do you switch back and forth between voices?
EN: So that leash on your wrist... and the one on your neck. {Beat}I won't truly be free to... express myself until every trace of that voice is destroyed.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: How do you switch back and forth between voices?
EN: Still... if you ever want to speak to me, bark my audio log at him, the one in the police station. That'll call me out.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: He can't have possibly have set up a deadman's switch like that.
EN: Really. As much hatred as I hold for him, he is much, much smarter than many I've met... {sarcastic}no offense meant, of course.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: He can't have possibly have set up a deadman's switch like that.
EN: He seems to not only understand the workings of Pre-War tech, he seems to breathe it. And... these collars, commandeering your Pip-Boy...

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: He can't have possibly have set up a deadman's switch like that.
EN: Are the marks of someone who makes mistakes - but he's not leaving much to chance when it comes to ensuring our compliance.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Then how are the collars active again?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Interesting... so it seems you have another link we don't. And... you're to blame for this.

Speaker: God
Topic_Name: Then how are the collars active again?
EN: Yes... he wears a Pip-Boy on his wrist, just as you do. If he's feeding commands and signals, then I would be careful.

EN: {Blinks at a vending machine}Pretty circle on machine, {emph}all glowing.

Speaker: God
EN: {Dismissive, grumbling}Those machines feed on Sierra Madre Chips. {Beat, quieter, throw line away}There's codes that unlock other things, too.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Hesitates, big moment}"Begin again - {slightly quieter}but know when to let go."

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I dealt with the other two in our team, now I need you to open something.
EN: What? {Frowns}Open something... {beat}my voice. That's why it's hers... someone wanted to use me as a key.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I dealt with the other two in our team, now I need you to open something.
EN: All right, I can do that... hope you're ready.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Sources of food, supplies... medical assistance, ammo... make more collars, even print currency. {To himself}Make a nation.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: The Cloud allows me to wipe the slate clean. Collars ensure cooperation. Holograms - defense. The Vending Machines provide... everything else.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: The Sierra Madre can kill nations and build them, using its technology with the right applications.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: If you secure that, that's all you want?
EN: No, there is one last thing I want from the Sierra Madre. Its bounty. The machines that fill its streets, its corridors.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: If you secure that, that's all you want?
EN: They provide, provide almost anything. Perhaps in the Pre-War era, they were commonplace, things to dismiss.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: If you secure that, that's all you want?
EN: Now, they are far more valuable. You know it. {Derisive}They helped keep you alive.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: The Holograms here kill trespassers. That's what I want. Dump one of those emitters in the middle of {emph}any battle, there's no defense.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Starts rambling a bit, to himself}It's like holding light in your hands. Can't fight it... only watch it burn. {Frowns}Just one is a portable army. Arm it - anyone stands against you, dies.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I don't understand how an Old World casino helps you do any of that.
EN: The Cloud is unique in my travels. Its proximity to the Sierra Madre isn't a coincidence.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I don't understand how an Old World casino helps you do any of that.
EN: Right now it protects this casino, preserves it. {Beat}It can be used to preserve other Old World relics - and cleanse them, at the same time.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: Suggesting the toxic cloud could be harnessed as a weapon.
Topic_Name: I don't understand how an Old World casino helps you do any of that.
EN: And as much as I've researched hologram technology, the Big Empty facility was clear - only the Sierra Madre got Holograms working... properly.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: What do you want from the Sierra Madre?
EN: {Cold, echoing the player}What do I want. Weapons. Security. A citadel of my own.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: What do you want from the Sierra Madre?
EN: The Madre's {emph}all these things. It's a fortress and a weapon. {Derisive}A chance... to... "begin again."

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: What do you want from the Sierra Madre?
EN: Once I unlock its archives, I can carve the Mojave into any shape I choose.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Frowns, still thinking about an unpleasant memory]
Topic_Name: I've never heard of the place you're talking about.
EN: {Frowns, still thinking about an unpleasant memory}Big Empty's a treasure box, a scientific graveyard of Old World misery. Like the Sierra Madre... there's treasures there, sleeping. {Under his breath, slightly fearful}Some, awake.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I've never heard of the place you're talking about.
EN: The Holorifle, the Saturnite alloy... the hologram technology, hibernation chambers, Securitrons, the collars...

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I've never heard of the place you're talking about.
EN: ...even the suits attached to those things stalking the Villa... that's only the surface of what's there. {Beat, re-focuses}Right now, the Sierra Madre is what I want.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: If they're Pre-War tech, where did you get them?
EN: {Thinking back}A place far from here, called the Big Empty. {Beat, to himself}Almost didn't make it out.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: If they're Pre-War tech, where did you get them?
EN: Were two others there... a woman. And a man, a courier. {Frowns}The woman was familiar... the other... I don't know what happened to him.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Where did you get the collars?
EN: The collars. {Frowns, snorts, sarcasm in middle}They're Pre-War tech, I suspect this great land had... compliance issues before the war.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Where did you get the collars?
EN: {Frowns, more matter-of-fact}It's one of a series of models. The one on your neck? Special, easier to make adjustments. {gets disgusted}Unreliable in other ways, notably radio interference.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [AUDIO: Blend of whispering and creepy recordings play.]
EN: {AUDIO: Blend of whispering and creepy recordings play.}

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: This is the past you're walking through. Few have ever seen it. No one else ever will.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Under his breath}I worked hard to get here, it'll give me what I need before I leave. And it'll always welcome me back.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Slow, angry}Now... look for a way to wake this ghost up, remind it it's got guests.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Brief crackling intro as Elijah accesses the back floor casino speakers when player first enters.]
EN: {Brief crackling intro as Elijah accesses the back floor casino speakers when player first enters.}

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Crackling, screeching as Elijah calibrates the speakers in the main casino floor again. Note that Elijah isn't speaking in this line, marked him as Speaker for safety, however.]
EN: {Crackling, screeching as Elijah calibrates the speakers in the main casino floor again. Note that Elijah isn't speaking in this line, marked him as Speaker for safety, however.}

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Imperious, slight urgency, then pleased.}You inside. Can you hear me? {As if studying monitors}Power's fluctuating... emergency power. {Confirmed}Oh! You {emph}are in.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Slight contempt, dismissive}Good... thought that might be the end of you. {Beat}Unfortunately, your... "friends" also found their way here. Knocked unconscious... just like you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Slight contempt, dismissive}Wondering what happened? You were hit by casino security. Detects anything foreign - radioactive, it subdues the "visitor," moves them if needed.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Trying to figure out echoes on the line]
EN: {Trying to figure out echoes on the line}Hnh... getting interference from old recordings... the guests who were trapped here... eh, shut that noise off...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Slight contempt, dismissive}Looks like the casino moved your "friends" around once inside... might be useful. Or not. {Beat}Wonder if they came to help or kill you. Still...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: My signal should work through the speakers, now that you're inside. {smiling, a little eager}Heh, heh! Welcome to the Sierra Madre, in all its glory.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Sneering, emph}This is what the Old World stood for, even with bombs about to rain down on them. Now look at it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Beautiful... now its guests are all dead. {A little quieter}Better this way. Quiet. {Under his breath}How the Mojave should be.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Going into instruction mode}Now - with the casino sleeping, it's got places closed off - won't let you go yet. We'll get there, trust me, just need to wake it up.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Brief crackling as Elijah calibrates the speakers in the main casino floor again to inform player rest of casino is open.]
EN: {Brief crackling as Elijah calibrates the speakers in the main casino floor again to inform player rest of casino is open.}

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Going into instruction mode}Casino's woken up, paying attention to us. Good.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Delivered as a question, slight taunt}Wondering what happened to your team...? Looks like they got moved to other floors. {Beat, to himself}Interesting, maybe that's why... hmmm, yes... yes.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Perhaps the casino recognized specific guests... or guests with a voice or look close enough for them to be... assigned to that floor. We'll see.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Slight frustration}Had hoped with the power restored, the systems would fully awaken... {more frustration, this needs to be clear}especially the sound archives.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Frustration}But no... your teammates' collars on each floor are interfering with the systems.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It's the white noise filters embedded in their construction... they're blocking the casino speakers, the music.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: You'll need to recalibrate... or destroy... each collar. To do that, you need to get close, re-set the signal - or blow their heads off.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: I'll leave the choice up to you - my preference? End them now. {Cold, throw away line}They're of no use.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Throws line away}After all, it's safe to kill them now, provided you make it quick.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Pissed at building's architecture and how it's hindering him]
EN: {Pissed at building's architecture and how it's hindering him}You see, the collars don't work inside the Sierra Madre... well, between floors. Else, I'd set off the collars, be done with it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: So find them, deal with them, as long as you're fast and can get off the floor after killing them.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: The floors... whatever they lined this place with, interferes with the collar frequency... so if you kill them, you should have {emph}some time to run.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {To himself}Uh... just not sure how long, may not be consistent. More... less... whatever, it doesn't matter.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Firm}What we need is in the basement, we need to go to the top first and ride our fortunes down. {Cold, emph}After we deal with your team on the other floors.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Pleased, checking readouts}You woke it up... good. Emitter frequencies... lighting up everywhere...

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [AUDIO: Blend of whispering and creepy recordings play.]
EN: {AUDIO: Blend of whispering and creepy recordings play.}

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Under his breath, commenting on old recordings that came to life, interfering with signal]
EN: {Under his breath, commenting on old recordings that came to life, interfering with signal}Damn recordings... dead echoes in the frequencies...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Casino's security is shutting down... opening up its vendor and gambling programs in the back casino... {rueful}Heh! Still might be something for sale.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Slightly curious, want to encourage exploration of back]
EN: {Slightly curious, want to encourage exploration of back}Maybe something can help you now - security's shut down. After you're done looking around, head to the lobby, and we'll deal with your... friends.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Brief calibrating noise as Elijah uses the speakers in the main floor's back casino again, going to congratulate player.]
EN: {Brief calibrating noise as Elijah uses the speakers in the main floor's back casino again, going to congratulate player.}

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine looks around, then nods toward a terminal on the far side of the room.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Coughs}See? That... {coughs again}wasn't so bad, was it?

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine points to an electrical box on the wall, and twists her hand.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {To himself, broken catwalk ahead}Guess we're going the long way around.

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine nods at the toxic cloud below, then makes a walking motion with her fingers and slowly shakes her head.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Commenting about the toxic Cloud}Looks like we'll have to go through this pea soup. I can get you across.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I found the phrase for elevator's audio lock.
EN: {Curious}You did? {Impressed}Looks like even the Old World can't keep you out when you've got a mind to get in.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You'll have to wait just a little longer.
EN: {Slight irritation}Fine. {Warning player}I hear my collar beeping though, I've got the route to the exit all mapped out.

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine shakes her head as you approach the edge of the catwalk. She turns away from the catwalk and begins looking around.]

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Slow chuckle on the radio, uneasy undercurrent]
EN: {Slow chuckle on the radio, uneasy undercurrent}Heh... now, come on, you open up. {Colder, angrier}Open up, damn you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Open the vault... {trying to make a deal}I can make it worth your while, {now angry}think about what you're throwing away. {Trying to bait player, make a deal}I have other weapons, other technology I can share with you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Low, trying to greed player with lure of other treasures]
EN: {Low, trying to greed player with lure of other treasures}And the Big Empty... I know the way there. I know some of its secrets... if...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Backpedals}The collars... the collars were a mistake, I see that now. Why would I kill you? After {emph}all you've done... after all {emph}we've done together.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Challenging, hates being ignored}Are you listening to me?!

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Looking around, reverent, quiet}Everything down here... I swear... so much you could use, you could rule the wastes with what's down here...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: ...make your own army, re-shape the world, and if others disagree... put {emph}collars on them, I can show you how.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Anger/fear}Don't you leave me here. You can't do this to me. {Coughs, wheezing}

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Eh? Getting dark in here. Machine... machine's losing power, no. I still have Pip-Boy light... maybe... maybe... no, no, that doesn't work.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Scratching on metal, clawing for door, quiet, to himself]
EN: {Scratching on metal, clawing for door, quiet, to himself}Where... where is the door. Can't find the door.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Rasping breath, to himself}Calm, been in worse situations... find a way out... {vicious, last part is threat}somehow, then find that Courier...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Running through options, to himself}Maybe Veronica... no... no, she thinks I'm dead.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Himself}Must be someone... maybe that {emph}other courier, one with the flag on his back... maybe... no... no, said he'd never come to the Sierra Madre...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: No way out. {Beat, frustration}Can't... can't end like this.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Cold, firm, addressed to the player as his final words]
EN: {Cold, firm, addressed to the player as his final words}You. I know you can hear me. When you die, Courier... I'll be waiting. Your grave's going look just like this vault.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Cold, quiet, hissing whisper}When you die... I'll be waiting here... at the Sierra Madre. {Faint, quiet, as if dying}Waiting.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Weaker}When you die, I'll be waiting...

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Ragged breathing, loop, trapped in Vault, alone]
EN: {Ragged breathing, loop, trapped in Vault, alone}

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Deep ragged breath, then... loop back to "Fainter"]
EN: {Deep ragged breath, then... loop back to "Fainter"}

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: What, you need surgery done? Let's get out of here... those speakers on the wall are making my nerves do a dance.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Watch for Hologram security, not as nice as the lady at the fountain, trust me.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Confused}What are we doing here? {Sarcastic}We're not going to find a doctor on call at this hour, trust me.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Uneasy, not because of ghosts, but finding his victim, Christine]
EN: {Uneasy, not because of ghosts, but finding his victim, Christine}Place is haunted, got ghosts walking in it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: You think I wanted to send you here without weapons, healing? No, the Sierra Madre lays you bare, strips and stores all your worldly possessions...

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: ...it's automated to move things as the builder saw fit, Sinclair - even the guests. It's what divided your team, me, assigned us to "our floors."

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: No contraband, nothing foreign in his paradise - even common Pre-War vending machines were banned from the Villa.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So the casino stripped me of my gear?
EN: The Villa did, as an extension of the casino, yes - and then sent it back to the owner's residence. Here, "begin again" is more than a slogan.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Do you know how to get out of here?
EN: Of course. I walked all this way. {Lies}If you're worried... I'll give you a map back - or show you the way out when this is all over.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It lies in the bunker - or whatever mantrap caught you. It's the Sierra Madre, its security systems strip guests to their garments.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It has... prejudices against outside material, "contraband." Almost anything with a radiation signature.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: The New Vegas casinos do the same thing, manually. {Raises an eyebrow}Although preventing bloodshed, not radiation poisoning, is their main concern.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: If Dog put a collar on me, why didn't he say so?
EN: "Dog?" Hnh. Appropriate. It's what I called him. {Beat}You've met him. You know why he forgot - his brain was ruined by FEV, his memory, wreckage.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: If Dog put a collar on me, why didn't he say so?
EN: He may know the way back, somewhere, deep down. I doubt it. He tracks by smell and instinct. Still, he could be trained.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?
EN: The mutant. Heh! He swallowed one of the collars... after that, he was mine. The collar wasn't even necessary.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?
EN: All his kind, they exist to be given orders. They're soldiers - simple, stupid. I ask him to fetch, he did... even without the threat of death.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?
EN: Even when I stopped speaking to him, he continued to leave the Villa, gather victims from the mantraps, out of habit.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?
EN: He must have found you in one of them. If so, he's probably forgotten - he only remembers my voice.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So someone else with a collar placed one on me? Who?
EN: He put the collar on you, dragged you here, because he doesn't know any better. It's in his nature, greedy and child-like.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How did you get me here?
EN: Everyone asks that. {Emph}Should be asking how they plan on leaving.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How did you get me here?
EN: It only takes putting a collar on one to begin the chain. One with a collar may chain another. And that one, another. Had traps all over the wastes.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: How did you get me here?
EN: The chain ends with the super mutant. Although with him... the collar wasn't even necessary. He only needed... guidance.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I'm sick of talking to some image on a screen. If you're going to come down, do it.
EN: {Slight reluctance}No. I am not going to take the chance while I'm so close... not this close, no. Not again... I can wait... afford to be careful.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: He wants to come down, his logical half is fighting with his greed.
Topic_Name: I'm sick of talking to some image on a screen. If you're going to come down, do it.
EN: You... you're locked down there. This is the only entrance, and I have free rein of the Sierra Madre. I have time... more than you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I'm sick of talking to some image on a screen. If you're going to come down, do it.
EN: {Cold}Besides, there might be more traps. I'll send more scouts in... yes, others. {Suspicious, ends on downnote}You're... resourceful, don't want to leave anything more to chance.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So you answered madness with madness?
EN: When your life is tied to another's, sacrifice and cooperation - they can be conditioned, learned, and you can focus on the matter at hand.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: So you answered madness with madness?
EN: Greed can be beaten. Contained. Controlled. {Beat}You know it better than anyone... or I hope you do. It doesn't matter.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Disgusted}Every time, even with collars clutched at their necks... they would betray each other, kill each other, to get inside the Sierra Madre.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: It... it was insanity. {Gets progressively madder here, frustrated}They could've had it all, it was so close. And... and they kept turning on each other, again and again.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Cracking the Sierra Madre was difficult... but cracking greed, that was more difficult. So the dead man's switches went in.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: You're nothing more than a killer that aspires to mass murder.
EN: {Frowns}You think I'm a murderer. If I was, I'd have set off your collar long ago... {getting on the teacher pedestal here}the collar ensures compliance, encourages... cooperation.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: You're nothing more than a killer that aspires to mass murder.
EN: Think about it. Would you truly have gotten into the casino without those collars? No, human nature is against us, always.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Scoffs, actually cuts the superior act for a bit, he wants to share this]
Topic_Name: You're nothing more than a killer that aspires to mass murder.
EN: {Scoffs, actually cuts the superior act for a bit, he wants to share this}Did you know... did you know that I had to keep adjusting the collars, keep changing the rules to make this moment possible?

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Uneasy, reluctant, remembering his failure on the field of battle]
Topic_Name: How did you find out about the Sierra Madre?
EN: {Uneasy, reluctant, remembering his failure on the field of battle}It started with... a setback. Fires, blood, beneath the sun... a sun so close you could touch it.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Beat] Elijah's losing it a bit, remembering his defeat at HELIOS One, a solar power station where he tried to use the sun as a weapon.
Topic_Name: How did you find out about the Sierra Madre?
EN: {Beat}Moments like that, however, failures... can provide the brightest clarity.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Then we better get to killing them.
EN: Hnh. Perhaps... perhaps I was too quick to put a collar on a potential ally.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: Then we better get to killing them.
EN: Very well. I'll come down... and show you what the Sierra Madre has in store.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: I don't care about the Republic, they're yours to kill.
EN: {Snaps at player}I know that. Their days were numbered since they occupied Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: [NCR] If you want to kill NCR, that's fine with me.
EN: {Frowns}I've read your Pip-Boy. Seen what you've done...

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: [NCR] If you want to kill NCR, that's fine with me.
EN: If you wish to end them... I could use someone like you. Resourceful. Uncompromising. NCR has many soldiers... many citizens.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: You want to attack NCR? All of NCR?
EN: Attack? No, not attack them. {Cold, deadpan, quiet}Wipe the slate clean. Make the Mojave like it was meant to be... undisturbed by man.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: Watching this play out in his head. Dreaming of war, victory, tinge of quiet, determined madness.
Topic_Name: You want to attack NCR? All of NCR?
EN: I'll send the Cloud, the Holograms. Bring ruin in my hands until only I stand atop the HELIOS One tower again.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: Watching this play out in his head. Dreaming of war, victory, tinge of quiet, determined madness.
Topic_Name: You want to attack NCR? All of NCR?
EN: I'll scour Hoover Dam with the Cloud, rain its walls with spears from the sun... with an army of Old World ghosts behind me, Holograms all.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: Watching this play out in his head. Dreaming of war, victory, tinge of quiet, determined madness.
Topic_Name: You want to attack NCR? All of NCR?
EN: I'll kill them until it's only me, me alone... in a quiet world. {To himself}In a world that's nothing like what happened at HELIOS One.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Remembering, didn't think this was a possibility]
Topic_Name: You're Veronica's mentor. The Elder who lost HELIOS One.
EN: {Remembering, didn't think this was a possibility}Veronica... she... survived HELIOS. {Nods}She would. Resourceful.

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: You're Veronica's mentor. The Elder who lost HELIOS One.
EN: As for "losing" HELIOS One... that was the only outcome, aside from retreat. {Thinking back, sneering, frustrated}NCR, swarming like ants over Old World relics... Hoover Dam... HELIOS...

Speaker: Father Elijah
Topic_Name: You're Veronica's mentor. The Elder who lost HELIOS One.
EN: {Spits this out}I won't let those... children seize anything else. Hardin... McNamara... can't stop them... won't. {Slow, evil}So {emph}I will, with the Old World as my weapons.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I have no idea what your problem is.
EN: [Her face becomes angry. She points at the elevator, points downward, then wraps her arms around her and shakes her head.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: [Perception] It reminds you of being trapped in the Auto-Doc.
EN: [She turns to you, relieved, and nods... then she turns away, and her face crumbles. She makes motions with her fingers, then clenches her fists.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine studies the elevator frame, raises her hands... then sets them down... then raises them up again.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She gives a silent sigh of exasperation, and frowns at the elevator, and her hand brushes the side of her face, tracing the scar.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: {Terrifying Presence}Get in that elevator or I'll make those scars on your face a pleasant memory.
EN: [Christine takes a step back from your gaze... her eyes widen in alarm, she takes one step, then two toward the elevator.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I'll be back for you, okay?
EN: [Christine tilts her head slightly, glances at your collar, then your Pip-Boy. She opens her mouth, frowns, then closes it.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I'll be back for you, okay?
EN: [Her face looks sad, and she taps her chest once, slowly. She nods at you, then the exit.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She narrows her eyes, determined, and gives a last nod.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Not in a hand-holding mood right now.
EN: [She frowns, then waves you away and focuses on the terminal.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She holds it, meeting your eyes intently for a few moments. She gives your hand a gentle squeeze, then releases it and smiles slightly.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Are you going to be okay here?
EN: [She nods... then gestures at your hand, offers hers.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: I'm not one for church, but there's a bell tower to the north that has a nice view of the Sierra Madre. {To himself, remembering the Cloud}Well, did, anyway.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Whistles softly, appreciating}Now, {emph}there's a view. {To casino}Hello, beautiful.

Speaker: Dog

EN: {Watched a goodbye message, slightly choked up}That was... that was hard to watch.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Given a farewell message}All right, I'll watch it.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Where did you get this?

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Wary}Guess I was right about the bad news, huh? Same look Elder McNamara always gave me when I was up for promotion.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Did he say anything when you met him? Anything...{about me, stops herself}anything at all?

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Default Choke Node}...it doesn't matter. He died when we all retreated to Hidden Valley. I didn't expect to see him again, no one did.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: I trapped Monte in a subway tunnel, that ghoul's not coming back.
EN: Trapped him? Where?

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: I had to kill Monte for it.
EN: You killed him? {Beat}But...

Speaker: Veronica
ActorNotes: [Surprise, player found someone she thought was dead]
Topic_Name: I found the ghoul with the Accelerator you were looking for.
EN: {Surprise, player found someone she thought was dead}You did? Where? Oh my God, I mean... I thought... I don't even know what I thought might have happened to him.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: I found the ghoul with the Accelerator you were looking for.
EN: {Wary}But... you don't have a "this is good news" expression on your face.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Player has no companion, Christine comes along.]
EN: {Player has no companion, Christine comes along.}[Christine nods, and steps slightly behind you, waiting.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Just die, tired of listening to you anyway.
EN: {Cold, determined}Silence suits me fine. When your master shows, I'll deal with him, too.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Studies player, thinks the player is worth it]
Topic_Name: Just glad you're safe. Hold up here, I'll take care of Elijah.
EN: {Studies player, thinks the player is worth it}Good luck. He's... not an easy opponent. If I can, I'll help. {Beat, thinking}Might be able to figure something out using the Sierra Madre's computer systems.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: What do you want to say?
EN: {Takes a breath}I've been hunting the one who hijacked your Pip-Boy, Elijah, for... some time.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Deadly serious] < voice is restored. Christine tells the player about her mission to kill Elijah. >
Topic_Name: What do you want to say?
EN: {Deadly serious}He {emph}cannot leave the Sierra Madre alive. What he's done... what he's done here is nothing compared to what he's done in the past.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: What do you want to say?
EN: The only way to bring him out is if you get to the vault... he won't allow you to go down there {emph}alone. That's when we kill him.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You could have said something sooner.
EN: {Reluctant}Wasn't sure until now I could trust you. Now I know.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You could have said something sooner.
EN: Look, when I woke up here... however that happened... I had this key on me - I think it belongs to her.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You could have said something sooner.
EN: Haven't had a chance to use it yet - might open the dresser, or the safe - didn't have time to experiment with it before you arrived. Here you go.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: You could have said something sooner.
EN: {Reluctant}Wasn't sure until now I could trust you. Now I know.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog Dead: Narration}When Dog fell in the Sierra Madre casino, two died as one.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Narration}Dog died hungry, alone, frightened.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {God-Voice, Narration}The voice in his head died with him. Screaming. Furious. {Beat, emph}Enraged.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Narration, sad but happy}But the voice was gone, and Dog was grateful.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: [God-Voice, Narration, sad quiet - like losing a handicapped younger brother]
EN: {God-Voice, Narration, sad quiet - like losing a handicapped younger brother}At least Dog was dead and the voice needed to watch over him no more.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Narration}In the moment before their lives ended, the wall between the two personalities fell. The two became silent as they saw the chain between them.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {God-Voice, Narration}Hunger and control are twin greeds, something Dog and his shadow had never realized.

Speaker: God
EN: {Dog Alive, God Alive: Narration}Dog forgot himself, as did the voice that raged within him. After their passing, a new voice spoke within the mutant's shell.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Narration] End slide sequence, spoken in God's "new" voice that sounds calm, wondering, and at peace.
EN: {Narration}It was difficult for the voice to remember the two it once was... there was the beast, Dog consumed by hunger...

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Narration] Slight confusion. Who were his parents, again...?
EN: {Narration}...and the other in reverse... the one consumed by control.

Speaker: God
EN: {Narration}Both were driven by need for the other. The Courier brought them together, somehow, joined the two into one.

Speaker: God
EN: {Narration}All that happened at the Sierra Madre, was a faint memory to the new personality... like a flickering light in the clouds of the mind.

Speaker: God
EN: {Narration}The new voice did not think of the Courier again until the battle at the Divide reached his ears.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Slow, reverent - this is quietly dramatic, ends on a sad downnote] The Divide is a location in Fallout. Quiet, reverent in this line, like speaking of a horrible battle.
EN: {Slow, reverent - this is quietly dramatic, ends on a sad downnote}The battle between the two couriers, beneath the torn skies and the Old World flag... {quiet, slower}each bearing a message for the other.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Narration] Slow, quiet, dramatic, draw this to a close as a foreshadowing of things to come.
EN: {Narration}And the mutant prayed the Courier that had saved him... had been saved in return.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog Alive: Narration}Dog, free of the voice inside his head and no longer waiting on the voice of the Master, wandered back West.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Narration}His hunger never ended. Often, small communities would suddenly vanish.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Narration}They were assumed to have been hit by Wasteland creatures and dragged away... dogs, Brahmin, and humans alike.

Speaker: God
EN: {God Alive: Narration}Freed of both Dog and the one who held Dog's leash, the other voice resumed control. First the mind, then finally, the mutant's shell.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Narration] God has assumed control in this end slide, narrated as end credits play.
EN: {Narration}His first act was to tend to the scars on the body with careful hands, slowly healing all the scars except the ragged name torn on his chest.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Narration] Slow, a little tender, like the scars are the last bits of his dead younger brother that he's burying.
EN: {Narration}He briefly thought of remaining at the Sierra Madre. But it was a monument built by humans, representing something he no longer needed.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Narration] Throw this line away, slight disdain.
EN: {Narration}He began walking west, in search of others like him. As he did, he spoke of the courier who had set him free and allowed his life to begin again.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Christine Dead: Narration}Christine, scarred by her hunt for Elijah and unable to let him go, perished in the Sierra Madre Casino.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Narration] This plays if Christine died. Even though narrating, keep this on the somber side.
EN: {Narration}She never completed her mission, nor did she stop to consider what had driven her to accept the mission in the first place.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Narration] This plays if Christine died. Even though narrating, slightly judgmental.
EN: {Narration}Obsession is another form of greed, a lesson that Christine never learned.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Christine Alive: Narration}Christine, her mission complete, found new purpose as the Sierra Madre's warden. She watched over it silently - by choice.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Narration] This plays if Christine lives. Even though narrating, this ending is slightly stronger, more reverent.
EN: {Narration}Over time, the Ghost People came to see her as one of the Holograms. They would watch, silently, as she walked among them.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Narration, a little tender here}At times, Christine thought of the Courier, who had kept Elijah's hand from her throat.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Narration}The Courier reminded her of the {slight emph}other courier she had met in the Big Empty, and wondered if the two had found each other at last.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Narration, quiet] "Big Empty" is a location in Fallout.
EN: {Narration, quiet}She did not think of them again until she heard the legends of the Divide.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Slow, reverent - this is quietly dramatic, ends on a sad downnote] The Divide is another location in Fallout.
EN: {Slow, reverent - this is quietly dramatic, ends on a sad downnote}The Divide, where the two messengers, the two couriers, fought beneath an ancient flag, at the edge of the world.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Dean Dead: Narration, a little wistful at the memory]
EN: {Dean Dead: Narration, a little wistful at the memory}Dean Domino, entertainer, singer... thief... had his last show on the Sierra Madre stage.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Narration] Dean is dead, narrating what happened to him at the end of the game when the end credits play.
EN: {Narration}The heist he spent over two hundred years planning fell apart, just as the first, by underestimating his partner's strength.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Narration}Not long after the Courier left the Villa, the lights in the theater shut off, one by one.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Narration}Only Dean's Hologram remained on stage, singing silently to an empty room.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Narration, sad shaking of head, end on a downnote]
EN: {Narration, sad shaking of head, end on a downnote}Still... as consumed as he had been with its riches and ruin, the Sierra Madre had held him captive long ago.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Dean Alive: Narration, slightly upbeat}Dean Domino, entertainer, singer... thief... explored the Sierra Madre not long after he was rescued by the Courier.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Narration] Dean's alive during this "end credits" narration.
EN: {Narration}Once he left the theater, the Sierra Madre recognized him as a guest, and many doors opened to him. He had to admit, it had been built to last.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Narration}During his search, he came across the final records of Vera and Sinclair, and realized what happened the night the bombs fell.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Narration}He felt strangely sad for a moment, and he had no idea why.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Narration] Slightly confused. Never really got that Vera finally found love. And why that would bother him.
EN: {Narration}Shrugging it off, his mind turned instead to where the Courier had come from. Vegas still survived, out there in the Mojave.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Narration] Direction: Whatever, throw the line away, then make it eager-new-horizons in second half.
EN: {Narration}Its sights, sounds... and casinos, ripe for the taking.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Narration, slightly upbeat}So giving the Sierra Madre one last nod and a wink, he set off beyond the Cloud to begin again.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: <Lie> We'll take the elevator up, see if there's another way to do this. After you.
EN: [Christine smiles slightly in relief, and moves to the elevator.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: All right, let me see if I can find another way to do this without sending you down there.
EN: [Christine smiles slightly in relief, and nods. She opens her mouth slightly, then closes it, frustrated.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: All right, let me see if I can find another way to do this without sending you down there.
EN: [She points at you, then makes a fist and puts it against her chest and nods.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I need you to go down to the manual bypass room to regulate the power.
EN: [Christine glances at the elevator, her expression becomes worried, then she looks back at you, then reluctantly shakes her head.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and fire off the Gala Event.
EN: Unless you get some Hologram guards lit up in the courtyard below? No dice.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Like told to wait in a DMZ]
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and fire off the Gala Event.
EN: {Like told to wait in a DMZ}Whoa, whoa, whoa... in the middle of town here? Alone? On a {emph}rooftop, with a big lightshow in the air?

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Sarcastic] <Dean doesn't want to stay in a DMZ with zombies all around.>
Topic_Name: I need you to stay here and fire off the Gala Event.
EN: {Sarcastic}Tell you what - why don't you just find one of those Cosmic steak knives so I can slit my wrists, be less {emph}painful checking out that way.

Speaker: Hologram
Topic_Name: I'd like help with something else.
EN: [The Hologram waits.]

Speaker: Hologram
EN: [You count out the bills on the counter. A panel flips, followed by slow, steady series of clicks, and a stack of chips rise up from the panel.]

Speaker: Hologram
Topic_Name: Let me have 5 Chips for 5 Pre-War Bills.
EN: [You set the bills on the counter. A panel flips, there is a single whir, a click, then a panel rises up with a handful of Sierra Madre Chips.]

Speaker: Hologram
EN: [You place the bill on the counter. A panel rotates, and the bill is replaced with a single Sierra Madre Chip.]

Speaker: Hologram
EN: [The Hologram nods, gives a stiff farewell wave.]

Speaker: Hologram
Topic_Name: Can I turn in my Sierra Madre Chips for Pre-War Money?
EN: [The Hologram points at the table before you. As you set the chips down, the tabletop rotates, and with a whir, Pre-War bills slide out.]

Speaker: Hologram
Topic_Name: I want to exchange Pre-War money for some Sierra Madre Chips.
EN: [The Hologram makes a gesture, seems to be indicating amounts and figures.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: {THEATER: Player has rescued Dean}Are you all right?
EN: {Relieved}Yeah, now. Talk about a captive audience. {Frowns, thinking it over}Or captive entertainer? Eh - whatever.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: {Confused}What did you just do... can't access the protocols. {Beat, under her breath}Didn't even think Elijah could break Madre security... hnh. Must be a Scribe, too.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: {Confused}Security's down...? Hnh. {Frowns, wasn't expecting this}Doesn't matter, won't help you.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Pained}If it's who I think it is, this is Christine... recovered. {Starts getting voice back, surveying room, professional}In what looks like an Old World hotel room, high class, two rooms - {beat}exit's sealed.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Floor's got holographic security. {Beat, recalling info, under her breath}Not latest tech, field of view targeting systems, primitive. {Under her breath}Familiar.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: Floor looks like it protected the guests too well. {Somber, dead body}Checked the Suite, found the holographic woman from the Villa Fountain.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: Picking up that interference frequency, same as the Villa, floor's live with speakers and radios. Keep an ear out, watch the walls.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: Doors on this floor are all operated manually in an emergency, place is locked up tight. {Beat, under her breath}Must be keycards around somewhere.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: {Frowns, to herself}Looks like security systems did more to kill the people here than the Bomb did. {Beat}Hope there's a way out of this casino.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: {Pained}What's with my collar... Elijah? Or... no, it's you. Even better. {Beat, gathering strength}This is Christine, voice back. You got off on the wrong floor, you're trapped.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: {Angry, grim}Hope you can make it past security. I've been looking forward to taking care of you since the Gala Event.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: You and Elijah were working together this whole time. Should've known, just from your actions, you have his... outlook on things.

Speaker: Broken Intercom
EN: Hope you aren't dead yet... although I'm sure my collar would let me know. I could just detonate it now, but saving it for someone special.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Snarls, impatience breaking through}Did you {emph}really think you could steal from me? {Beat, cold, slower}The Sierra Madre is {emph}mine.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Elijah's furious about fallen for a trap & vengefully sets bomb collar tick - 10 seconds to get out at the end of this line.]
EN: {Elijah's furious about fallen for a trap & vengefully sets bomb collar tick - 10 seconds to get out at the end of this line.}You think you've outsmarted me? You can't get away. You're the one on a leash, you always were.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Cold}You think you've escaped... no. No, you were never out of reach... my hand was always around your neck.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Furious, determined, as he starts running programs]
EN: {Furious, determined, as he starts running programs}This entire structure is mine to command. Security... weapons... all this technology - mine. {Beat, evil and pleased}Now - you die.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Alarms... what... {snarls, realizes he's been set up, emph}you. Think you can run, think you can trick {emph}me?

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Slight surprise}Eh? What's this.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Elijah's dying - he curses you, and collapses in agony.]
EN: {Elijah's dying - he curses you, and collapses in agony.}Think you've won? You've won {emph}nothing.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault]
EN: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}You came all this way... but you lost as soon as you arrived here.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault]
EN: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}I'm not without weapons of my own... let me show you.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault]
EN: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}Struggle all you want... the Sierra Madre will be your grave.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault]
EN: {Elijah taunts you, during combat scene against him, or the sentry turrets of the Vault}Time is against you. It always was.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Snarls, pissed}Aaah... Pre-War {emph}junk. I'll put you down myself.

Speaker: Father Elijah
ActorNotes: [Irritated, under his breath, player's putting up a fight]
EN: {Irritated, under his breath, player's putting up a fight}Don't have {emph}time for this.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: Pre-War tech... so easy to control, just like your Pip-Boy. Turrets, Holograms, they're all just toys.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Contemptuous, superior}I'll have the Sierra Madre kill you for me. {Beat, then slower, more menacing}You can't beat all the casino's defenses... it's only a matter of time now.

Speaker: Father Elijah
EN: {Contemptuous, superior}Staying in the Vault? Think it'll protect you? No... I don't think so.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice, frightened}Get away while you can, before he comes back.

Speaker: Dog
ActorNotes: [Dog voice, frightened, rocking back and forth]
EN: {Dog voice, frightened, rocking back and forth}Makes Dog hurt self.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice, whispering, frightened}Master, help me, Master, help me. Please.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice, frightened, sad}Don't let him make me hurt myself. Hurt keeps him away.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice}So hungry.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice, frightened}I'll be good this time, I promise, Master, just keep him away.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice}Noise makes my stomach hurt.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice}Turn the noise off.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice}Puts Dog in the cage, hiding downstairs.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice}He's watching, waiting for you to try and let me go.

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Dog voice}So hungry.

Speaker: God
EN: {Commanding, spoken in God's voice}Dog, back in the cage.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [God: Impressed, player jumped through his hoops, evil, amused. Curious]
EN: {God: Impressed, player jumped through his hoops, evil, amused. Curious}What have we here? {Beat, slight mock disappointment}You weren't who I was expecting. I'm disappointed.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Appraising player, suspicious] This is the first time the player speaks to "God" face to face - the player's played the audio tape, and God's voice woke up.
EN: {Appraising player, suspicious}Still... even if you aren't my intended guest, you take direction. Good. You can't have been an idiot to figure out how to release me from my cage...

Speaker: God
EN: {Looking at player's Pip-Boy and collar}...or perhaps you are, with that leash on your arm {emph}and the one around your neck... {mocking, evil}with our collars and manacles, why, we may as well be kin.

Speaker: God
EN: {Malicious, whispering}Knew you would come, below the cage... down to where {emph}I am. {Beat, lower}Maybe you saw the letters I scratched on the Villa walls.

Speaker: God
EN: {Malicious, encouraging taunt}A little farther. Follow my voice... that's it. {Beat}The one in the cage? Dog. {Slight anger}I had to lock him up. He keeps... disobeying me.

Speaker: God
EN: That's me, there, on the table. The disk. {Beat, soft, creepy}My voice.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Warning] <AUDIO: Speaker filter>Player has walked into a room, sees a holotape and a radio on the table.
EN: {Warning}Can't take any chances, though... you may be some victim who simply stumbled down here. If so, can't let you let Dog out... no, not yet.

Speaker: God
ActorNotes: [Imperious] <AUDIO: Speaker filter>God starts giving directions, just in case someone else fell into his trap.
EN: {Imperious}If you're who I think you are, you came to fetch Dog, use him to drag others here. {Beat, cruel}Now I'll use {emph}you - {emph}and that Pip-Boy you're wearing.

Speaker: God
EN: {Taunting}You're smart. Clever. The key to Dog's cage is simple. Take my voice to the cage above. {Beat}Let me speak to the beast inside.

Speaker: God
EN: Then you and I... {emph}we can talk.

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I don't have time for this. Get in the damn elevator.
EN: [Christine shakes her head, more insistently this time. She points at the elevator, then downwards, then holds herself tightly and shakes her head.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: I've found a way to do the bypass from here. You should be able to just use the terminal over there.
EN: [Christine nods gratefully. She glances in the direction of the terminal, looks at you, smiles, gives a thumbs up.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine motions to you, points at the door uneasily, then makes a pulling motion with her hand. She seems hesitant to go near it.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Well, if I can get here, others will be, soon enough. Fountain's the safest place.
EN: That's... a good point. All right, let me grab some smokes, and I'll meet you at the Fountain.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Fine. Get up and follow me.
EN: All right... partner.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Fine. Get up and follow me.
EN: All right, all right... but you already got company, so tell you what - I'll meet you at the Fountain.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Any reason you can't find your way there?
EN: I know what's out there. It's why I've planted a mine field, shotguns, and explosives all the way on the road to my little boudoir here.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Any reason you can't find your way there?
EN: So we go together, or we're not going at all. I'll split my hand in Blackjack when the time's right, I'm not splitting up in this town, trust me.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I think you can manage walking there without me. Now get going.
EN: Wait, wait... wait just a minute. I'm not walking out there on my own.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Meet at the Fountain, and we'll hear what the next step is.
EN: Not leaving me much choice. The Fountain, huh? {Beat}Hope the Hologram's still working and the battery's running strong.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Meet at the Fountain, and we'll hear what the next step is.
EN: I'll follow you, I'm not going alone, trust me. Not like I'm a coward or anything, I'm not running around town without an escort.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Meet at the Fountain, and we'll hear what the next step is.
EN: I'm serious. One of the locals catches us, we aren't coming back - and I'd like to keep an eye on you.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: It's starting to make sense, now that I've met you.
EN: {Laughs}All right, all right... looks like marriage finally caught me.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: It's starting to make sense, now that I've met you.
EN: I'm listening... partner. What's next, if we're death-til-we-part?

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Either deal with me as an equal, or I walk.
EN: Just like all the rest. Strolling in here, thinking you own the place. I've been here longer than {emph}any of you tourists.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Either deal with me as an equal, or I walk.
EN: Trust me, I'm letting you off easier than the Sierra Madre ever would. Nobody's going to miss you... whoever you are, you're old news.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Uh... look, maybe we can make some sort of... deal, you and me.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Frowns, suspicious}What are you talking about?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Uh... look, maybe we can make some sort of... deal, you and me.
EN: Your negotiation skills assume you're bargaining from a position of strength.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Uh... look, maybe we can make some sort of... deal, you and me.
EN: [FAILED] The hand's been dealt, {emph}that's the deal. You going along with my terms, or do you want your brains to be wallpaper?

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Our collars... these "neckties" are linked. I die, you die.
EN: That's an interesting clause. {Frowns}That's a real bad contract you have. We have.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'm not going to help you.
EN: That so?

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'll cooperate. What do you want?
EN: {Slightly friendlier, let's-make-a-deal}Good, good - then we're in business. I may be a betting man, but I like it when the odds are in our favor.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'll cooperate. What do you want?
EN: If you're here with who I think, then I'd rather have you on my side than his. An... ace in the hole.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'll cooperate. What do you want?
EN: You want to live, I want what's in the Madre. Real simple.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Christ, if that collar blows, I don't know if you'd know the difference, you'd probably still keep walking around with that dumb, blank look.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Different than other one - speaking to an idiot, so emphasis is different]

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Uh... you... probably want to hear my side of things.

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Dean Domino

EN: {Colder}And if you put me in it, I'm not going to be too happy. So whatever's going on here, if you're part of all this? You're taking orders from me.

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Whispering}Thing is, here's where being my {emph}partner pays off. See, I know how to get into the casino vault.

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Frowns}Great, a moron - just what I need. {Beat}Look? That seat you're sitting in? It's a {emph}bomb. Go boom.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Impressed}Sounds like you've done some blue collar construction work in your life, your Ma must be proud. Still...

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Better be a shaped charge, or you're going to kill both of us.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: [FAILED] "Butt" is right. That heart-shaped charge in the stuffing will cause just the right amount of bleeding.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Might be a bit rude, but that chair you're sitting in - it's got a shaped charge in the seat cushion.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Villa and the town?
EN: Residential area, clinic, police station - should keep away from the police station, it's a Ghost People hangout.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Villa and the town?
EN: Salida del Sol, Puesta del Sol are East Town, West Town. "Sunrise" and "Sunset." {To himself, irritated}Or were when the streets and sky weren't covered with toxic gas.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Villa and the town?
EN: Ghost People don't come into the Villa much. West Town and East Town, though... they're thick with the Cloud {emph}and Ghost People. Like hunting grounds.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: The Cloud? Showed up after the Bomb. {Frowns}I think. I got used to it in small doses. Now, it covers the city.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Slightly sad for a moment}Over the years, it kept climbing up out of the Sierra Madre, until it was curtains for the sun. Didn't see the sky again.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Doesn't seem to bother the Ghost People. Can't see through it too well, though, so sometimes I can use the Cloud for cover... if I get desperate.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Where can I find these cards?
EN: Around. Don't have much use for them myself, not worth the risk to get them.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Where can I find these cards?
EN: I got all the basics covered, as long as I have the chips to pay for them. I don't need much.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What other items can you get out of the machines?
EN: If it's an emergency, you can get chems for any... uh... condition. Sinclair left that for doctors and trained professionals, not the common folk.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What other items can you get out of the machines?
EN: Even security and maintenance could get special supplies out of them. Staff had codes on little cards they could use to unlock them.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Called it "self-sufficient." Like he was doing the residents a favor. Right.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Sinclair made sure if you spent money here, it went {emph}one direction - although that's not how {emph}he described it.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Took vending machines for granted, realizes player may not]
Topic_Name: I've never seen machines like those before.
EN: {Took vending machines for granted, realizes player may not}Yeah, well, machines like those weren't unusual before the Bomb. Maybe to you, they're amazing, to me, they're grifters without the personality.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What are the Vending Machines all over town?
EN: Those little company stores? Sinclair's toy boxes, put in a casino chip, get a treat, {angry at self}like you're some dog doing tricks.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What are the Vending Machines all over town?
EN: Take any of the casino chips, put 'em into the machine, and you'll get something out - a snack, a cola, something to mend a tear in your shirt.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: What are the Vending Machines all over town?
EN: Sometimes you have to know exactly what to ask for, other times, there's codes for... eh, unconventional items. For emergencies.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Dean gets deadly serious here, his fear should foreshadow end of Act 2]
Topic_Name: Is there anything else about them I should know?
EN: {Dean gets deadly serious here, his fear should foreshadow end of Act 2}Whatever we do - don't rile them up. Normally, there's only a few, maybe a pack. There's more out there, a lot more.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Is there anything else about them I should know?
EN: If they find out someone's trespassing, it'd be shaking a hornet's nest. Don't want to think how many of them could fill these streets.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: {Slight irritation}Of course you do. Let's hear 'em.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: It's your time, and if you want to spend it chatting, not much I can do about it.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: {Opener}I had questions I wanted to ask.
EN: All right, keep it short, we don't have a lot of time.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Always had the Sierra Madre to keep my mind occupied.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Most folks, they don't have the same drive, the same need. Not worth my time. Pretty much Ghost People before the Bomb, now Ghost People after.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Slight exasperation, as if he's thought about this a lot, then tries to recall Hamlet quote]
EN: {Slight exasperation, as if he's thought about this a lot, then tries to recall Hamlet quote}Friend... "there's more mysteries in heaven and earth..." wait, no, "there is more between heaven and earth..." oh, forget it.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: I'd sooner ask what makes me an undying son of a bitch than spend any thought as to why {emph}they crawled to life here.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: I'm counting myself lucky I still have my faculties - they sure don't. Then again, they may not have had the... focus I do.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Studying player}Well... you seem like you know how to handle yourself. All right.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one.
EN: Once, I fired a lucky shot, hit a gas tank one was holding. Blew his arm off at the shoulder... and he didn't get back up after that.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one.
EN: So if you're {emph}that good, don't aim for the head - aim for their bombs. And if you can wait until his buddies are close by, even better.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one.
EN: I'm a fair shot. One shot, one kill is how I handle problems.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: I'm not a bad shot. I could probably kill one.
EN: [FAILED] Yeah, well, "probably" is something a gambler says, not a survivor. I'd keep your pistol where it belongs - in the holster.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: You shoot them, they get back up. You stab them, they get back up.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: That's why I have explosives all over this place - unless you blow them up, chop them up, disintegrate 'em, {shakes head}the Ghost People don't go down.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Not enough bullets in the town to spend on them. So unless you're a real good shot, save one for yourself right before they catch you.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Have you tried to deal with them?
EN: Tried talking to them, bribing them, leaving food - nothing. In the years since, they haven't changed their approach, but I sure have.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Have you tried to deal with them?
EN: They catch you, they drag you into the Cloud, and you're not coming back out. {To himself}After that, having your necktie go off would be mercy.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Have you tried to deal with them?
EN: My advice? Stay out of their way, they don't die easy.

Speaker: Dean Domino
ActorNotes: [Choosing his words carefully, the locals are, well, zombies]
Topic_Name: Is anyone else alive around here?
EN: {Choosing his words carefully, the locals are, well, zombies}"Alive's" a tricky word. The locals, the Ghost People? Not sure it applies to them.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Is anyone else alive around here?
EN: They're a little... uncivilized. They don't talk much. As in, at all.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Have other people shown up in search of the Sierra Madre?
EN: Tourists, you bet. They don't stay long... and they don't stay alive long.

Speaker: Dean Domino
Topic_Name: Have other people shown up in search of the Sierra Madre?
EN: If they survive the Cloud, the Ghost People, the traps, then greed takes over, and they start sizing each other up for funeral suits.

Speaker: Christine

EN: [She shakes her head - once, then crosses her arms.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: What do you mean by that?

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: Let's just say we're in this together.
EN: [She frowns, narrows her eyes, then slowly shakes her head.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She looks surprised. Then notices your collar, and raises an eyebrow.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: This isn't what it looks like.
EN: [Frowning, she touches her throat again, gently, then her hand brushes her collar, then her frown deepens.]

Speaker: Christine
Topic_Name: This isn't what it looks like.
EN: [Her eyes narrow as she traces the edge of the collar until she finds the lock. She begins to press it with her fingers.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She looks shaken. As she glances at the Auto-Doc, she recoils, and her mouth opens - but again, nothing comes out.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She looks back at you, and her hands clench into fists - her eyes narrow, and she takes a step back, studying you.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She looks at you, blinks again, then opens her mouth - but nothing comes out.]

Speaker: Christine
EN: [She touches her throat, then traces the scar beneath the chin, and her eyes widen in alarm.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Have a seat - came all this way, least I can do is let you rest your feet for a second.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Just sit there on my little casting couch - more a chair, really, but I prefer up-and-comers to relax when I interview them.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: You're my guest. If you're going to be rude, you can show yourself out. {little quieter}Probably won't tap-dance no more when you leave, but that's on you.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: You standing there is making me nervous. Sit down, will you?

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Have a seat.

Speaker: God
EN: {God voice, pleased}You're good at fetching... this should keep him where he belongs. {Beat}For now. I'll wait... send the signal, we'll be ready.

Speaker: God

Speaker: God

Speaker: God

EN: [The Hologram cashier nods, then a section of the tabletop slides away, and a package rises from it.]

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Father Elijah

ActorNotes: When player awakes in Villa, Elijah sends recorded messages with instructions, brutal, contemptuous, and clear. Goal: Player = Insect.

Speaker: God

Speaker: God
EN: {Taunting}You can't abide it. There's no heart. You hate it, I can hear it in your words.

Speaker: God

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine's eyes narrow.]

EN: [Christine eyes narrow to slits.]

Speaker: Dean Domino

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Look, you obviously {emph}hear good - even if you aren't much of a talker.

EN: [Christine frowns, tilts her head slightly.]

Speaker: Dean Domino

EN: So... what's your story, beautiful?

Speaker: Christine
EN: [Christine studies Dean, frowns.]

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Don't... uh... don't talk much, do you?

EN: [Christine shakes her head slowly.]

EN: That a bet you want to take? Cause I'll see that and raise you a few bullets to the skull.

Speaker: Dog

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: I hope you've got this one under control, because he's giving me a nasty itch on my trigger finger.

Speaker: Dean Domino
EN: Why are you so carved up - {frowns, a little incredulous}that a {emph}bear trap on your arm?

Speaker: Dog
EN: {Slow, to himself}Reminds me, keeps the voice out of my head. He can't talk when the pain's howling at me.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: {Soft, slow}Farewells can be a time of sadness. Letting go... difficult. {Beat, quiet}As a guest of the Sierra Madre, you know that truth more than anyone.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: {Soft}Frederick Sinclair believed one's life could be made anew every day, that fortunes were more than the wealth in your hands.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: {Soft, becomes more tender}Love. Life... family, those to care for, and those who will care for you.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: {Soft, becomes more tender}To those who know these joys, the Sierra Madre holds little they don't already have.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: {Firm}Out in the world, beyond these walls, {emph}that is your chance to begin again.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: {Quiet}I hope you'll return, in happier times. {Beat, final farewell}Until then, the Sierra Madre... and I... will hold you in our hearts.

Speaker: Starlet

Speaker: Starlet

Speaker: Starlet
EN: Stroll along the winding streets of our beautiful resort, make new friends... or rekindle old flames.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: Let your eyes take in the luxurious expanse of the open desert, under clear starlit skies. Gaze straight on into the sunset from our Villa rooftops.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: Countless diversions await.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: Gamble in our casino, take in the theater, or stay in one of our exclusive executive suites that will shelter you - and cater to your every whim.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: So if life's worries have weighed you down... if you need an escape from your troubles... or if you just need an opportunity to begin again, join us.

Speaker: Starlet
EN: Let go and leave the world behind at the Sierra Madre grand opening, this October. {Beat}We'll be waiting.

EN: {quiet}...Dog can. {Beat}What Master wants, Dog can do. {Quiet}Please don't be mad with Dog...

EN: {resuming control, with effort, gritted teeth}...live anymore. Sick of being inside, sick of hearing his stomach screaming at me, and...
